english: The Mongol Altay runs southeast from the high mountains of central Asia towards the Gobi. Snow-covered peaks, glaciers and valleys separate the dry basins of western Mongolia from the lands beyond the range. Ancient rock carvings in the Altai record changes in human life over thousands of years, from hunting and herding to the mounted cultures that came to dominate the steppe.
simp_chinese: 蒙古阿尔泰山从中亚高山向东南延伸，直至戈壁。积雪覆盖的群峰、冰川和山谷将蒙古西部的干旱盆地与山脉另一侧的土地隔开。阿尔泰山的古代岩刻记录了数千年间人类生活的变化，从狩猎、放牧，到后来主导草原的骑马文化。

english:
Mongomo lies in the forested interior of the country facing the Gulf of Guinea, north of the sources of the Ntem and Woleu rivers. The dense equatorial forest shelters a rich variety of animal and plant life. Long before European rule, the wider region was home to forest peoples as well as communities speaking Bantu languages. Migration brought successive groups into the forests over many generations; the Fang and related peoples moved southwards through the interior towards the river headwaters.

The later city of Ciudad de la Paz lies here.
simp_chinese:
蒙戈莫位于几内亚湾内陆的森林地带，在恩泰姆河与沃勒河源头以北。茂密的赤道雨林庇护着种类繁多的动植物。远在欧洲人统治之前，这片广大地区就有森林居民和说班图语的社群生活。经过许多代人的迁徙，不同人群陆续进入森林；芳人及其近邻穿过内陆，向南迁往河流源头一带。

后来的和平城即位于此地。

english:
Möng Pai, known in Burmese as Mobye, was a Shan state in the southern highlands. Its ruling house was drawn into the struggles for the throne of Ava during the sixteenth century. Sao Hso Kaw Hpa of Mobye became king of Ava in 1545, taking the name Narapati. His reign was challenged by his own brother and ended in 1551, when he fled before the forces of Bayinnaung's rising Toungoo kingdom.

The later city of Loikaw lies here.
simp_chinese:
孟派是掸邦南部高地的一个土邦，缅甸语称莫别。十六世纪，其统治家族卷入了阿瓦王位的争夺。莫别的召梭科法于1545年成为阿瓦国王，称那腊波底。他的统治受到兄弟挑战，1551年又在新兴的东吁王国勃应曩军队面前逃离，王位随之易手。

后来的垒固即位于此地。

english: Mongping lies in the mountainous country east of the Salween, west of Kengtung. It was one of the local mongs associated with the Kengtung realm, where Shan rulers governed a mosaic of valley settlements and upland peoples. Forested ridges divide its valleys from the great river to the west and from neighbouring communities in the eastern Shan highlands.
simp_chinese: 孟平位于萨尔温江以东、景栋以西的山区。这里是与景栋政体相联系的地方“勐”之一，掸族统治者管理着由谷地聚落与高地居民组成的多样地区。森林覆盖的山岭将它的河谷与西面的大江以及东部掸邦高地的邻近社群分隔开来。

english: Mong Ton lies east of the Salween in the southern Shan highlands, among the hills of the Daen Lao range. Its position places it between the Shan country and the northern Thai borderlands. A local tradition connects the town with King Naresuan of Ayutthaya: a stupa is said to contain his ashes, although accounts of the king's death and burial differ. The town's setting reflects the close ties between these neighbouring upland regions.
simp_chinese: 孟东位于萨尔温江以东的掸邦南部高地，坐落在掸老山脉的山丘之间，处于掸地与泰国北部边境地带之间。当地传说将此地与阿瑜陀耶国王纳黎萱联系起来：据说一座佛塔藏有他的骨灰，尽管有关国王去世和安葬的记载并不一致。这段传说反映出相邻高地地区之间的密切联系。

english:
Möng Yang, called Mohnyin in Burmese, was a powerful Shan principality in the northern Irrawaddy region. Its rulers governed a country of valleys and forested hills and stood among the northern powers whose fortunes were closely tied to those of Ava. The principality's position placed it between the Burmese heartland and the Shan lands reaching toward Yunnan.

In the early sixteenth century its sawbwa, Sawlon, led a coalition of Shan states against Ava. After repeated campaigns, the allies captured the city in 1527 and placed Sawlon's son Thohanbwa on its throne. Their success did not bring lasting unity: Sawlon was murdered by his own ministers, and rivalries weakened the coalition. In 1557 Bayinnaung of Toungoo conquered Möng Yang as his expanding kingdom brought the northern Shan states under its authority.
simp_chinese:
孟养在缅甸语中称为莫宁，是伊洛瓦底江北部地区强大的掸族小邦。其统治者管辖河谷与林木覆盖的丘陵，属于命运与阿瓦紧密相连的北方势力。小邦位于缅甸核心地区与延伸至云南方向的掸族地区之间。

十六世纪初，孟养土司思伦率领掸邦联盟进攻阿瓦。多次征战之后，盟军于1527年攻占该城，让思伦之子多汉发登上王位。胜利并未带来长久的团结：思伦被自己的大臣杀害，竞争又削弱了联盟。1557年，东吁的莽应龙征服孟养，扩张中的王国将北方掸邦纳入其统治。

sources.title: the shan states and the british annexation.pdf

english: The Mohnyin country lies among the wooded hills and valleys west of the upper Irrawaddy. To its northwest, the great lake of Indawgyi occupies a basin surrounded by forested slopes. Streams feed the lake, whose waters escape northward toward the Mogaung River. The region formed part of the country associated with Möng Yang, the Shan principality known in Burmese as Mohnyin.
simp_chinese: 孟欣地区位于伊洛瓦底江上游以西，山丘与河谷间覆盖着森林。西北面的因道基大湖坐落在林木环绕的盆地里，山溪汇入湖中，湖水再向北流往孟拱河。这片地区属于与掸族小邦孟养相关的土地；孟养在缅甸语中亦称莫宁。

english:
The Moniga estuary, associated with the old name Tejungo and the port of Pebane, opens onto the north-central Mozambique coast. Its river mouth offered shelter to vessels moving along the coast, but refuge did not guarantee access to supplies on land.

In April 1595 the Dominican missionary João dos Santos entered the Tejungo while returning from Sofala toward Mozambique. Bad weather forced his vessel into the river mouth, where the party remained for thirty-two days. His account describes a country suffering famine and occupied by Zimba forces. Local Makua people had fled to an offshore island, and the travellers could not obtain provisions from the mainland. The episode connects this particular estuary with the upheavals of the late sixteenth-century coast: maritime movement depended on shore communities whose own security and food resources were exposed to warfare and scarcity.
simp_chinese:
莫尼加河口联系着旧称特琼戈及佩巴内港，面向莫桑比克中北部海岸。河口为沿海往来的船只提供避风处，但获得庇护并不意味着能够从陆上取得补给。

1595年四月，多明我会传教士若昂·多斯桑托斯从索法拉返回莫桑比克途中，因恶劣天气进入特琼戈河口，一行人在此停留三十二天。他的记述称，当地发生饥荒，津巴军队占据沿岸，马夸居民逃往近海岛屿，旅人无法从大陆取得食物。这个事件将具体河口联系到十六世纪末海岸的动荡：船舶航行依赖岸上社群，而社群自身的安全与粮食资源，又承受战争和匮乏带来的压力。

english: Monkey Point lies on the southern Caribbean coast of Nicaragua, in a region of forest, rivers and coastal wetlands. Archaeological remains document a long history of occupation along this shore. Rama communities are descended from Indigenous peoples living on Nicaragua’s Caribbean coast at the time of European contact, and their territory includes the coast around Monkey Point and the river mouths to its south.
simp_chinese: 猴角位于尼加拉瓜南部加勒比海岸，周围是森林、河流与滨海湿地。考古遗存记录了这片海岸悠久的居民历史。拉马社群是欧洲人接触时居住在尼加拉瓜加勒比海岸的原住民后裔，他们的地域包括猴角附近海岸及其以南的河口。

english: Monmouth stands where the River Monnow joins the Wye, near the border of Wales and England. Its medieval stone bridge and gatehouse guard the approach across the Monnow, while the remains of its castle overlook the town. The future Henry V was born in the castle in the late fourteenth century. During the Civil War the stronghold changed hands and was damaged before being dismantled to prevent its further use as a fortress.
simp_chinese: 蒙茅斯位于蒙诺河与怀伊河交汇处，靠近英格兰和威尔士边境。中世纪石桥及门楼守卫着跨越蒙诺河的入口，城堡遗迹俯瞰城镇。未来的亨利五世于十四世纪末出生在城堡中。英国内战期间，要塞几经易手并遭破坏，随后被拆毁，以防再度用作堡垒。

english: Mono is the largest of the Treasury Islands, a small group south of Bougainville and west of the Shortland Islands. A sheltered harbour separates it from neighbouring Stirling Island, while reefs border the surrounding shores. The Treasury and Shortland groups lie among the waterways connecting Bougainville with the western Solomon Islands.
simp_chinese: 莫诺是布干维尔以南、肖特兰群岛以西特雷热里群岛中最大的岛屿。受庇护的港湾将它与邻近的斯特灵岛分开，珊瑚礁环绕周边海岸。特雷热里和肖特兰群岛位于连接布干维尔与所罗门群岛西部的水道之间。

english: Mono is one of the Treasury Islands south of Bougainville, separated from neighbouring Stirling Island by sheltered water. Island communities inhabited the group long before British lieutenant John Shortland reached it in 1788. Later ships crossed nearby Bougainville Strait on routes toward Asia.
simp_chinese: 莫诺是布干维尔岛以南特雷热里群岛的一座岛屿，与邻近斯特灵岛之间有受掩护水域。1788年英国海军中尉约翰·肖特兰抵达之前，岛屿社群早已在此生活。后来驶往亚洲的船只穿越附近的布干维尔海峡。

english: The Monocacy winds south through central Maryland to join the Potomac River. Its name is commonly traced to a Shawnee expression meaning “river with many bends,” though another interpretation describes a well-fenced garden. The river drains a broad valley between the wooded ridges of the interior and carries its waters onward through the Potomac to Chesapeake Bay.
simp_chinese: 莫诺卡西河向南蜿蜒流过马里兰中部，汇入波托马克河。河名通常被认为来自肖尼语，意为“多弯的河”，另一种解释则是“围得严实的花园”。河流汇集内陆森林山脊之间的广大河谷的水，送入波托马克河，最终流向切萨皮克湾。

english: Monona lies in the country of the Little Sioux River, which winds southwest across Iowa to meet the Missouri. Along the river and tributaries such as Mill Creek and Waterman Creek, communities of the Mill Creek tradition built villages around a thousand years ago. Farther downstream, the Little Sioux passes through the country later called Monona, before entering the broad Missouri valley.
simp_chinese: 莫诺纳位于小苏河地区。小苏河蜿蜒穿过艾奥瓦，向西南流入密苏里河。约一千年前，米尔溪文化的社群沿河及米尔溪、沃特曼溪等支流建立村落。小苏河继续向下游流过后来称作莫诺纳的地区，进入宽阔的密苏里河谷。

english:
The Monongahela flows north through the Appalachian plateau to meet the Allegheny and form the Ohio. Its name refers to riverbanks whose earth falls away into the water. The valley contains many sites of the Indigenous culture now named for the river, whose people cultivated maize and lived in carefully arranged villages. Some settlements contained dozens of structures, and their inhabitants exchanged goods with neighbouring peoples.

During the French and Indian War, the lower Monongahela became the scene of a major British defeat. In 1755 General Edward Braddock's expedition advanced toward the French position at the forks of the Ohio, but French forces and their Indigenous allies attacked near the river. Braddock was mortally wounded in the fighting and his army retreated.
simp_chinese:
莫农加希拉河向北流过阿巴拉契亚高原，与阿勒格尼河汇合形成俄亥俄河。河名指河岸土壤崩落入水的景象。河谷中有许多后来以此河命名的原住民文化遗址；当地人种植玉米，居住在布局整齐的村落里。有些聚落包含数十座建筑，居民也与邻近族群交换物品。

法国与印第安人战争期间，莫农加希拉河下游成为英国军队败北之地。1755年，爱德华·布拉多克将军率远征军向俄亥俄河交汇处的法国据点进军，却在河边遭到法军及其原住民盟友袭击。布拉多克身受致命伤，军队随即撤退。

english:
Monopoli stands on the Adriatic shore of Apulia, its old town and harbour facing the sea beneath fortified walls. The port served the agricultural country inland and formed part of the chain of coastal towns linking the Kingdom of Naples with the eastern Mediterranean. Its small harbour lay close to the houses and churches of the old coastal settlement.

Venice controlled Monopoli during the Italian wars at the end of the fifteenth century. In 1496 the Venetians enlarged the harbour's jetty, investing in the port alongside their other Apulian possessions. Spanish rule followed, and coastal fortifications were strengthened against attacks from the sea. Monopoli's harbour remained a place where the fortunes of a local town and the ambitions of maritime powers met.
simp_chinese:
莫诺波利位于阿普利亚亚得里亚海岸，旧城与港口在城墙下方面向大海。港口服务于内陆农业地区，也是连接那不勒斯王国与东地中海的一系列沿海城镇之一。小港口紧邻沿岸旧聚落的房屋和教堂。

十五世纪末意大利战争期间，威尼斯控制莫诺波利。1496年，威尼斯人扩建港口防波堤，同其他阿普利亚领地一道投资此港。此后西班牙统治者加强沿岸防御，以应对海上进攻。莫诺波利港始终是地方城镇命运与海上强权抱负交汇之处。

sources.title: de Divitiis Companion on the Renaissance in SI 2023 offprint low compressed.pdf

english:
The Monqui lived around Loreto on the eastern shore of the Baja California peninsula. Their homeland lay between the Gulf of California and the dry mountains inland. Marine resources and foods gathered from the peninsula supported communities in a land with little rain and only scattered reliable water.

In 1697 the Jesuit Juan María de Salvatierra established Nuestra Señora de Loreto among the Monqui, creating the first lasting Spanish mission on the peninsula. Loreto became the base from which missionaries and soldiers extended their settlements north and south. The mission drew Indigenous people into a new religious and economic system, while disease and colonial expansion caused severe disruption. Supplies from the mainland across the gulf were essential to the survival of the new settlement.
simp_chinese:
蒙基人居住在下加利福尼亚半岛东岸的洛雷托一带，故土介于加利福尼亚湾与内陆干山之间。降雨稀少，可靠水源零散，海洋资源与半岛采集物供养着当地社区。

1697年，耶稣会士胡安·玛丽亚·德·萨尔瓦铁拉在蒙基人地区建立洛雷托圣母传教区，成为半岛上第一个持久的西班牙传教聚落。洛雷托由此成为传教士和士兵向南北扩展的基地。传教区将原住民纳入新的宗教和经济体系，疾病及殖民扩张则造成严重破坏。来自海湾对岸大陆的补给对新聚落的存续不可或缺。

sources.title: Mission Nuestra Señora de Loreto Conchó

english:
Mons stands on a hill over the Trouille river in the county of Hainaut, whose counts held their court in its castle. The counts' fortifications were renewed in the mid-twelfth century, and in 1290 John II of Avesnes built a second circuit of walls that, unlike the first, defended the town as well as the castle. Most of its houses were still timber then, taken from the surrounding forests. The Black Death struck in 1348, and legend says the epidemic ceased after a procession with the relics of Saint Waldetrudis, the origin of the Mons ducasse.

In 1356 Countess Margaret II died and her son William of Bavaria-Straubing became count, entering Mons on 26 February 1357; one of his first acts was to oblige the burghers, Lombards and Jews to keep arms, the origin of the town's citizen militias. In 1433 Philip the Good took the title of Count of Hainaut, passing the county from the Bavarians to Burgundy, and the marriage of Mary of Burgundy to Maximilian of Austria brought it under the Habsburgs in 1477. A clock tower was built in 1497 on the site of the later belfry, and in 1515 Charles V was crowned Count of Hainaut when the town held about 9,500 people, with tanneries, shoemakers and weavers along the Trouille.

During the Eighty Years' War Louis of Nassau took Mons by surprise on 24 May 1572 to hand it to the King of France, but the Duke of Alba retook it on 21 September. From 1580 to 1584 Alexander Farnese made it the seat of the Spanish Netherlands government. The French besieged it in 1655, Marshal Luxembourg in 1678, and Louis XIV in 1691 with Vauban in charge of the siege, and the town was restored to Spain in 1697. After the Utrecht treaties it passed to the Austrian Habsburgs, though Dutch troops garrisoned it.
simp_chinese:
蒙斯坐落在埃诺伯国特鲁耶河上方的一座山丘上，伯爵们的宫廷设在城堡里。12世纪中叶伯爵们翻新了防御工事，1290年阿韦讷的约翰二世修建了第二圈城墙，与第一圈不同，这圈城墙同时保护城镇而不仅是城堡。当时大多数房屋仍是木结构，木料取自周围的森林。1348年黑死病肆虐，传说在抬着圣瓦尔德特鲁德遗物游行之后瘟疫停止了，这就是蒙斯“杜卡斯”庆典的起源。

1356年玛格丽特二世女伯爵去世，她的儿子巴伐利亚-施特劳宾的威廉继位为伯爵，1357年2月26日隆重进入蒙斯；他最早的举措之一是要求市民、伦巴第商人和犹太人始终携带武器，这是城镇市民民兵的起源。1433年好人菲利普取得埃诺伯爵的头衔，使伯国由巴伐利亚家族转归勃艮第，勃艮第的玛丽与奥地利的马克西米利安的联姻使它在1477年归哈布斯堡家族。1497年在后来钟楼的位置上建起了钟塔，1515年查理五世在城中加冕为埃诺伯爵，当时城里约有9500人，特鲁耶河沿岸有鞣革匠、鞋匠和织工。

八十年战争期间，拿骚的路易于1572年5月24日突袭占领蒙斯，企图把它交给法国国王，但阿尔巴公爵于9月21日夺回了城市。1580至1584年，亚历山大·法尔内塞把西属尼德兰政府设在蒙斯。1655年法军围城，1678年卢森堡元帅围城，1691年路易十四亲临围城，由沃邦主持攻城，1697年该城归还西班牙。乌得勒支条约之后它划归奥地利哈布斯堡，但驻军为荷兰部队。

english:
Monselice lies at the southern edge of the Euganean Hills, southwest of Padua. Its old town grew around the Rocca, a hill fortified with five successive circuits of walls, some of which still stand. The Roman name Mons Silicis recalled the stone of the area, while the medieval fortress commanded the surrounding plain.

The town had enjoyed local self-government as a commune in the twelfth century. The Ghibelline lord Ezzelino da Romano strengthened Monselice in the thirteenth century, making it a principal stronghold. It later passed to the Carraresi of Padua and in the fifteenth century to the Republic of Venice. The town remained within the Venetian mainland state until the republic's fall; after a period of French rule it entered the Austrian Empire.
simp_chinese:
蒙塞利切位于帕多瓦西南、尤加尼丘陵南缘。旧城围绕罗卡山发展，山上修筑了五道城墙，其中部分仍然保存。罗马名称蒙斯西利西斯使人想起当地石材，中世纪堡垒则俯瞰周围平原。

十二世纪，城镇曾作为公社享有地方自治。十三世纪，吉伯林派领主埃泽利诺·达罗马诺加强蒙塞利切的防御，使其成为主要据点。此地后来归帕多瓦的卡拉雷西家族所有，十五世纪又成为威尼斯共和国的一部分。城镇一直处于威尼斯大陆领地之内，直到共和国覆灭；经历一段法国统治后，它归入奥地利帝国。

english:
Monsol was a capital of the Teke kingdom, whose rulers held authority over a wide region north of the Congo River. Its market drew goods and people from the interior towards the routes leading to the Atlantic coast. Around 1700, the French trader Jean Barbot described a thriving trade there in ivory, copper and captives. Agents from Loango bought these goods at Monsol, and enslaved people were made to carry merchandise on the journey to the coast.

The later city of Brazzaville lies here.
simp_chinese:
蒙索尔是泰凯王国的一处都城，其统治者在刚果河以北的广大地区行使权力。这里的市场汇集内陆货物和往来人群，通向大西洋海岸的道路也由此延伸。约1700年，法国商人让·巴尔博记述了当地兴盛的象牙、铜和人口交易。来自洛安戈的商人在蒙索尔采购货物，受奴役者则被迫在前往海岸的途中搬运商品。

后来的布拉柴维尔即位于此地。

sources.title: James Green - Material Values of the Teke Peoples of West Central Africa Complete 5 31 18.pdf

english: Mont-de-Marsan grew at the meeting of the Douze and Midou, whose waters form the Midouze. The viscount of Marsan established a fortified settlement here, using the confluence to protect his castle. In 1344 Gaston Fébus strengthened the town's defences and built the castle of Nolibos. The Wars of Religion later brought rival armies to Mont-de-Marsan, which was taken by Blaise de Monluc in 1569.
simp_chinese: 蒙德马桑兴起于杜兹河与米杜河的汇合处，两河在此形成米杜兹河。马桑子爵在这里建立设防聚落，利用河流交汇处保护城堡。1344年，加斯东·费比斯加固城防并建造诺利博城堡。宗教战争后来使敌对军队来到蒙德马桑；1569年，布莱兹·德·蒙吕克攻占了城镇。

english:
Montaigu lies in lower Poitou in western France. During the Hundred Years' War an English garrison occupied the town after the Treaty of Brétigny in 1360; French forces under Clisson and Bertrand du Guesclin recovered it in 1373. In 1473 Louis XI acquired the lordship amid his policy towards neighbouring Brittany.

During the Wars of Religion the town changed hands between Catholic and Protestant forces, including a siege in 1580. Its castle defences were dismantled in 1586. In March 1793, during the Vendée uprising, insurgents from surrounding communities took Montaigu and executed a number of republicans.
simp_chinese:
蒙泰居位于法国西部下普瓦图。百年战争期间，1360年《布勒丁尼条约》后英军驻守此地，1373年克利松和贝特朗·杜盖克兰率法国军队收复。1473年，路易十一在处理与邻近布列塔尼的关系时取得蒙泰居领地。

宗教战争期间，城镇在天主教和新教军队之间多次易手，1580年曾遭围攻。城堡防御工事于1586年拆毁。1793年3月旺代起义爆发后，周边社区的起义者占领蒙泰居，并处决了一些共和派人士。

english: Montaigut commands the Combraille from a hill with wide views over the surrounding country. A castle was built on its summit in the twelfth century, and a town grew below its walls. Together with other fortified sites near the Cher valley, the castle formed part of a frontier defence during the Hundred Years' War. It was destroyed in 1633 on the orders of Cardinal Richelieu.
simp_chinese: 蒙泰居特坐落在一座视野开阔的山丘上，俯瞰孔布拉耶地区。十二世纪，山顶建起城堡，城墙下逐渐发展出一座城镇。百年战争期间，城堡与谢尔河谷附近的其他设防据点共同构成边境防线。1633年，城堡奉黎塞留枢机之命被毁。

english: Montalbán lies beneath a rocky height once crowned by a castle of the Order of Santiago. The fortress became the seat of the order’s chief commandery in Aragon in 1275. Its church of Santiago also served a defensive purpose: a gallery above the side chapels formed part of the military arrangements of a religious and martial establishment that held authority over the surrounding territory.
simp_chinese: 蒙塔尔万坐落在岩石高地下方，山顶曾耸立着圣地亚哥骑士团的城堡。1275年，这座要塞成为骑士团在阿拉贡的总领地中心。圣地亚哥教堂也兼具防御功能：侧礼拜堂上方的廊道是军事设施的一部分，见证着这一宗教与军事机构对周边土地的统治。

english:
Montalcino stands on a commanding hill in southern Tuscany, where a fortified town overlooked farmland, vineyards, and routes through the Sienese countryside. Rural households supplied grain, wine, livestock products, and other resources, while craftsmen and merchants supported urban life. Walls and a fortress reflected the strategic importance of a settlement whose economy still depended on the productive land around it. Markets joined the needs of town residents with the labor of surrounding villages.

In the Middle Ages the town was known for tanning and leatherwork. After Siena surrendered in 1555, Sienese exiles maintained a republican government at fortified Montalcino. Their resistance ended in 1559, when the remaining territory passed to the Florentine state. Accounts differ on the exact date of the town's surrender.
simp_chinese:
蒙塔尔奇诺位于托斯卡纳南部显著山丘，设防城镇俯瞰农田、葡萄园和穿越锡耶纳乡村的路线。农户供应粮食、酒、畜产品及其他资源，工匠与商人则支持城市生活。城墙和堡垒反映战略价值，但经济仍依赖周围生产土地。市场将城中居民需要同村庄劳动结合起来，防御与日常生活因而需要同一乡村基础支持。

中世纪时，城镇以制革和皮革制品闻名。1555年锡耶纳投降后，锡耶纳流亡者在设防的蒙塔尔奇诺维持共和政府。抵抗于1559年结束，剩余领地转归佛罗伦萨。不同记载对城镇投降的确切日期有分歧。

english: Montalegre stands in the high country of Barroso, close to the Galician frontier. Ancient burial mounds and fortified hill settlements attest to the long occupation of these mountains; later the border encouraged the construction of castles. Afonso III granted Montalegre a charter in 1273, making it a center of the lands of Barroso. Successive kings confirmed or renewed its privileges, and after the Portuguese succession crisis John I gave the district to Nuno Álvares Pereira in recognition of his support.
simp_chinese: 蒙塔莱格里坐落在巴罗苏高地，靠近加利西亚边境。古老的墓丘和设防山堡见证了人们在群山中长久的定居历史；后来边境的存在又促使人们修筑城堡。阿方索三世于1273年授予蒙塔莱格里特许状，使它成为巴罗苏地区的中心。后继国王确认或续订了它的特权；葡萄牙继承危机之后，若昂一世将这一地区赐予努诺·阿尔瓦雷什·佩雷拉，以酬谢他的支持。

english: Montánchez occupies a high position in the hills of central Extremadura, crowned by a castle commanding the surrounding country. After conquering the town, Alfonso IX of León granted the castle and its lands to the Order of Santiago in 1230. The grant included pastures, woods and waters as well as the settlement itself, and required the order to conduct war and make truces in the king's name. The castle was subsequently rebuilt under the order's authority.
simp_chinese: 蒙坦切斯地处埃斯特雷马杜拉中部的高丘，山顶城堡俯瞰四周乡野。莱昂国王阿方索九世征服此镇后，于1230年将城堡及其土地授予圣地亚哥骑士团。赠地不仅包括聚落，还有牧场、林地和水源；骑士团须以国王的名义在此作战或缔结停战。城堡后来在骑士团统治下重建。

english: Montargis stands among the waterways of the Loing, beneath the remains of a castle that once guarded the town. In 1427, during the Hundred Years’ War, English forces besieged it for weeks. A French relief force under Dunois and La Hire attacked the besiegers, while the defenders opened sluices and flooded the ground. The English withdrew, giving the French a welcome victory before the siege of Orléans.
simp_chinese: 蒙塔日坐落在卢万河的水道之间，城堡遗迹俯瞰着城镇。1427年百年战争期间，英军围攻此地数周。迪努瓦与拉伊尔率领法军前来解围，守军则开启水闸，淹没战场。英军最终撤退，使法国人在奥尔良之围前取得了一场振奋人心的胜利。

english:
Montauban was founded in 1144 by the Count of Toulouse on a rocky height above the Tarn. Its charter granted liberties to the inhabitants, who governed their town through consuls. The brick-built settlement prospered between Toulouse and Cahors and became a bishop's seat in the fourteenth century.

Montauban embraced Protestantism and became a major Huguenot stronghold during the Wars of Religion. In 1621 its defenders resisted a siege by Louis XIII's army, forcing the king to withdraw after months of fighting. The town finally submitted to royal authority in 1629, and its defences were dismantled. Catholic religious communities returned, while the old Protestant stronghold came under closer royal control. Its turbulent history left a deep mark on the churches and streets of the city.
simp_chinese:
蒙托邦由图卢兹伯爵于1144年建在塔恩河上方的岩石高地上。建城特许状赋予居民自由，他们通过执政官治理城镇。这座以砖建筑成的聚落在图卢兹与卡奥尔之间繁荣起来，十四世纪成为主教座所在地。

蒙托邦接受新教，在宗教战争中成为胡格诺派的重要据点。1621年，守军抵御路易十三的围攻，经过数月战斗迫使国王撤军。1629年，城镇最终向王权屈服，防御工事被拆除。天主教宗教团体重新回到城中，昔日的新教据点也受到王权更严密的控制。这段动荡的历史在城市的教堂与街道上留下了深刻痕迹。

english:
Montauk occupies the eastern end of Long Island, where a narrow peninsula reaches into the Atlantic. It is the homeland of the Montaukett, an Algonquian-speaking people who farmed, fished, hunted and made shell beads known as wampum. The beaches and waters around the peninsula also supported a whaling tradition in which Montaukett people took part.

In 1653 a force led by Ninigret attacked and burned a Montaukett village, killing warriors and taking captives, among them a daughter of the sachem Wyandanch. Colonial purchases progressively reduced Montaukett control over the peninsula, while families continued to work in whaling. The Mohegan minister Samson Occom came to teach among them in 1749. At the end of the peninsula, the Montauk Point lighthouse was completed in 1796 to guide vessels approaching the coast.
simp_chinese:
蒙托克位于长岛东端，狭长的半岛伸入大西洋。这里是蒙托克特人的故土，他们使用阿尔冈昆语，从事农耕、捕鱼和狩猎，并制作称为贝珠的贝壳饰物。半岛周围的海滩与水域还孕育了捕鲸传统，蒙托克特人亦参与其中。

1653年，尼尼格雷特率队袭击并烧毁一座蒙托克特村庄，杀害战士并掳走俘虏，其中包括首领怀安丹奇的女儿。殖民者不断购地，逐渐削弱蒙托克特人对半岛的控制，但许多家庭仍参与捕鲸。1749年，莫希干传教士萨姆森·奥科姆来到这里教学。半岛尽头的蒙托克角灯塔于1796年建成，为接近海岸的船只指引航向。

english:
Montbéliard, known in German as Mömpelgard, was a county on the edge of the Burgundian Gate. Its castle overlooked a town whose ruling family linked French-speaking lands to Württemberg. The marriage of Henriette of Montbéliard and Eberhard of Württemberg brought the county into that house, under which it remained for centuries.

Duke Ulrich of Württemberg encouraged reforming preachers in Montbéliard in the 1520s. Guillaume Farel preached there in 1524, though pressure from Catholic Swiss cantons later compelled his departure. Pierre Toussain arrived in the town in 1535 and opened a school for boys and girls. In 1538 Count George abolished the Mass and Catholic ceremonies, establishing evangelical worship in the county. Montbéliard's religious life was shaped by both Lutheran and Swiss religious reforming influences.
simp_chinese:
蒙贝利亚尔，德语称默姆佩尔加德，是勃艮第门边缘的一个伯国。城堡俯瞰城镇，统治家族将这片法语土地与符腾堡联系起来。蒙贝利亚尔的亨丽埃特与符腾堡的埃贝哈德联姻，使伯国归入该家族，此后延续数世纪。

符腾堡公爵乌尔里希在1520年代支持蒙贝利亚尔的宗教改革布道者。纪尧姆·法雷尔于1524年在此传教，后来在瑞士天主教州的压力下被迫离开。皮埃尔·杜桑于1535年抵达，并开办男女儿童学校。1538年，格奥尔格伯爵废除弥撒及天主教仪式，在伯国内确立福音派礼拜。蒙贝利亚尔的宗教生活受到路德宗和瑞士改革思潮的共同影响。

english: Montblanc grew into an important town of southern Catalonia through its markets, fairs and administrative role. Its Gothic church of Santa Maria and ring of walls reflect the prosperity of the fourteenth century. Peter the Ceremonious ordered the defences strengthened during war with Castile, and townspeople and neighbouring communities helped build the circuit of towers and gates. In 1387 Montblanc also gave its name to a duchy.
simp_chinese: 蒙特夫兰克凭借集市、商会和行政职能，发展为加泰罗尼亚南部的重要城镇。哥特式圣玛丽亚教堂和环绕城镇的城墙反映了14世纪的繁荣。与卡斯蒂利亚交战期间，礼仪者佩德罗下令加强防御，镇民和周边共同体共同修建了带有塔楼与城门的城墙。1387年，蒙特夫兰克还为一座公爵领命名。

english: Montbozon was a fortified town on the Ognon in the county of Burgundy. Bridges crossed the river's two branches before the town, and a castle stood above the settlement. In the seventeenth century plague repeatedly struck the region; a solemn annual Mass was established at Montbozon in honour of the relics of Saint Sebastian. The lordship belonged in part to the king and in part to the Jesuits during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, while a Dominican convent remained in the town until the Revolution.
simp_chinese: 蒙博宗是勃艮第伯国奥尼翁河畔的一座设防城镇。桥梁在镇前跨越河流的两条支汊，城堡则立于聚落上方。十七世纪，瘟疫屡次袭击这一地区；当地设立每年举行的庄严弥撒，敬奉圣塞巴斯蒂安的圣髑。十七至十八世纪，领地一部分属于国王，一部分属于耶稣会；镇上的多明我会修道院一直延续至大革命。

english: Montbrison lies at the foot of the Forez mountains, a centre of the county of Forez. The heraldic hall known as the Diana preserves a rich painted ceiling, a sign of the standing of its noble patrons. In 1527 Francis I confiscated the lands of Charles III, Duke of Bourbon, including Forez. The king was received in the hall in 1536 as the new Count of Forez, bringing royal authority into a setting shaped by the county's older rulers.
simp_chinese: 蒙布里松坐落在福雷山麓，是福雷伯国的中心。被称为“黛安娜厅”的纹章大厅保存着华丽的彩绘天花板，彰显贵族赞助者的地位。1527年，弗朗索瓦一世没收波旁公爵夏尔三世的领地，其中包括福雷。1536年，国王以福雷伯爵身份在大厅受到接待，王权进入了这处由伯国旧统治者塑造的场所。

english: Montcenis stood on a height in the Autunois, the seat of a ducal castle and a Burgundian bailliage. The barony included the lands where Le Creusot later developed. In the eighteenth century François de la Chaise acquired Montcenis and obtained rights to exploit coal deposits in the neighbourhood. The royal foundry established at Le Creusot in the 1780s drew on these resources, marking a new industrial chapter in a district long governed from the older hilltop town.
simp_chinese: 蒙瑟尼位于欧坦地区的高地，曾是公爵城堡和勃艮第司法辖区的驻地。其男爵领包括后来勒克勒佐发展的土地。十八世纪，弗朗索瓦·德·拉谢兹购得蒙瑟尼，并取得开采附近煤矿的权利。1780年代设立的勒克勒佐皇家铸造厂利用这些资源，为长期由山上旧城管辖的地区开启了工业发展新篇章。

english: The great lake of Monte Alegre lies in the floodplain of the lower Amazon, surrounded by channels and forest. The Maecuru River enters the lake west of Monte Alegre, while channels connect this low-lying várzea country with the Amazon. As the great river rises and falls through the year, water spreads across the floodplain and the extent of the lake changes.
simp_chinese: 蒙特阿莱格里大湖位于下亚马孙漫滩，周围分布着水道与森林。马埃库鲁河在蒙特阿莱格里以西注入湖泊，水道则把这片低洼的泛滥地与亚马孙河相连。大河一年中涨落时，河水漫过平原，湖面的范围也随之改变。

english: Laguna del Monte is part of the chain of lakes in the western pampas of Buenos Aires. It receives water from the neighbouring Cochicó lagoon and drains towards Laguna del Venado within a basin without an outlet to the sea. Water levels fluctuate greatly between drought and flood, changing the shoreline and exposing traces of earlier human occupation. Shallow water and surrounding grasslands form a distinctive wetland amid the plains.
simp_chinese: 蒙特潟湖属于布宜诺斯艾利斯西部潘帕斯的连锁湖泊。它接纳邻近科奇科潟湖来水，再流向贝纳多潟湖，所在盆地没有通往海洋的出口。水位在干旱与洪水之间大幅变化，改变岸线，也暴露早期人类活动的遗迹。浅水与周围草原在平原上构成独特湿地。

english: Montefeltro is a mountainous district of the northern Apennines, encompassing the upper valleys of the Marecchia and Conca and the heights around San Marino. It gave its name to the Montefeltro family, whose lords came to rule Urbino and played a prominent part in the struggles of the Guelph and Ghibelline factions. The district's valleys and hilltop strongholds lie between Romagna and the lands farther inland.
simp_chinese: 蒙特费尔特罗是亚平宁山脉北部的山地区域，包括马雷基亚河和孔卡河上游的谷地，以及圣马力诺周围的高地。蒙特费尔特罗家族得名于此，家族领主后来统治乌尔比诺，并在圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的斗争中扮演重要角色。这一地区的河谷和山顶堡垒分布在罗马涅与更内陆的土地之间。

english:
Montego Bay opens on the northwestern coast of Jamaica, where a harbour serves the surrounding parish of Saint James. During the eighteenth century it grew into a major port for the export of sugar and the trade in enslaved Africans. Ships arrived from Africa, Britain and North America, linking the plantations of western Jamaica with Atlantic markets and making the town a centre of commerce.

In 1831 Samuel Sharpe, an enslaved Baptist leader in Montego Bay, organised a strike to demand freedom. The action spread through western Jamaica and developed into a major rebellion. Colonial forces suppressed it, and Sharpe was tried and hanged in Montego Bay in 1832. The uprising added to the pressures surrounding the abolition of slavery in the British Empire.
simp_chinese:
蒙特哥湾位于牙买加西北岸，其港口服务于周围的圣詹姆斯地区。十八世纪，它发展为重要港口，出口食糖并参与受奴役非洲人的贸易。来自非洲、英国和北美的船只驶入港湾，将牙买加西部的种植园与大西洋市场连接起来，也使城镇成为商业中心。

1831年，蒙特哥湾受奴役的浸礼会领袖塞缪尔·夏普组织罢工，要求获得自由。行动蔓延至牙买加西部，发展为大规模起义。殖民军队镇压了起义，夏普于1832年在蒙特哥湾受审并被处绞刑。起义加剧了英国帝国内要求废除奴隶制的压力。

english:
Monteleone stands on a height above the Tyrrhenian coast of Calabria, near the site of ancient Hipponion. Its churches and castle overlook the slopes and routes leading towards the sea. A Dominican convent founded in 1455 was enlarged under the Pignatelli family in 1543, adding to the religious buildings of the town.

The earthquakes of 1783 damaged Monteleone and devastated much of southern Calabria. The king appointed Francesco Pignatelli as vicar with extraordinary powers to organize relief and reconstruction. He established his headquarters near the town, receiving reports from officials and physicians sent to the stricken settlements. The emergency required shelter for survivors and the restoration of damaged roads. Monteleone thus became a centre from which the response to the disaster was directed.
simp_chinese:
蒙特莱昂内坐落在卡拉布里亚第勒尼安海岸上方的高地，靠近古代希波尼翁遗址。教堂与城堡俯瞰山坡及通向海边的道路。1455年建立的多明我会修道院于1543年在皮尼亚泰利家族主持下扩建，增添了镇上的宗教建筑。

1783年的地震损坏蒙特莱昂内，并摧毁卡拉布里亚南部大片地区。国王任命弗朗切斯科·皮尼亚泰利为拥有特别权力的总督，组织救济与重建。他在镇附近设立总部，接收派往受灾聚落的官员和医师报告。紧急工作包括安置幸存者和修复道路。蒙特莱昂内因而成为指挥灾后应对的中心。

english: Montemor-o-Novo grew beneath a castle on a prominent hill in the Alentejo. Sancho I granted a charter in 1203 to encourage settlement and defense, and the medieval fortifications were expanded under later kings. By the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries regional commerce and the court's long stays at nearby Évora helped bring prosperity. The Cortes met here in 1495, when Manuel I resolved to pursue the sea route to India. He granted the town a new charter in 1503, and settlement spread down the northern slope beyond the walls.
simp_chinese: 新蒙特莫尔兴起于阿连特茹一座高丘上的城堡下方。桑乔一世于1203年授予特许状，鼓励定居和防御，后继国王扩建了中世纪的防御工事。十五至十六世纪，区域贸易和王室长期驻留附近的埃武拉，帮助城镇走向繁荣。1495年等级会议在此举行，曼努埃尔一世决定探寻通往印度的海路。他于1503年授予城镇新特许状，聚落也越过城墙向北坡扩展。

english: Montendre lies beneath a hilltop castle overlooking the woods and heath of Saintonge. In 1402, during the Hundred Years’ War, seven French knights fought seven Anglo-Aquitanian knights near the castle in a celebrated trial of arms. French forces took the stronghold in 1452. Later, Protestantism gained adherents here, and Montendre became a Huguenot place of security under the settlement of 1598.
simp_chinese: 蒙唐德尔坐落在山顶城堡下方，城堡俯瞰桑通日的林地与荒野。百年战争期间的1402年，七名法国骑士与七名英格兰及阿基坦骑士在城堡附近进行了一场著名的比武。1452年，法军攻占要塞。此后新教在当地获得信徒，依照1598年的和约，蒙唐德尔成为胡格诺派的安全据点。

english: Montepeloso stands on a hill above the Bradano valley in Basilicata, its cathedral overlooking the surrounding farmland. In the fifteenth century the priest Roberto de Mabilia brought a remarkable gift from Padua to his native town: a relic of Saint Euphemia accompanied by paintings, statues, a font and illuminated books. The cathedral was rebuilt in 1777, but the works and the saint's cult preserved a connection between the Lucanian hill town and the artistic world of northern Italy.
simp_chinese: 蒙泰佩洛索坐落在巴西利卡塔布拉达诺河谷上方的山丘，大教堂俯瞰周围农田。十五世纪，神父罗贝托·德马比利亚从帕多瓦带回一份珍贵礼物，献给故乡：圣欧菲米娅的圣髑，以及绘画、雕像、洗礼池和彩绘书籍。大教堂于1777年重建，但这些作品和圣人的崇敬保存了卢卡尼亚山城与北意大利艺术世界的联系。

english: Monterado lay in the gold-bearing country of western Borneo, inland from the coast of Sambas. Chinese miners established settlements around the workings and formed associations, or kongsi, to govern their affairs. By the late eighteenth century several mining communities had joined the Heshun federation, whose centre was at Monterado. Its members organized labour and defended their interests in negotiations and conflicts with neighbouring powers. The goldfields brought migrants, merchants and local rulers into close contact, making the inland mines a source of both wealth and political rivalry.
simp_chinese: 打劳鹿位于婆罗洲西部的金矿区，在三发海岸的内陆。华人矿工围绕矿场建立聚落，并组成公司管理共同事务。到十八世纪末，几个矿业社群联合成立和顺公司，以打劳鹿为中心。公司组织劳作，在与周边势力的交涉和冲突中维护自身利益。金矿吸引移民和商人，也使他们与地方统治者密切往来；内陆矿区由此成为财富与政治争夺的所在。

english: The Monterey coast lies in central California, where bays, open ocean and inland valleys offered varied resources to Indigenous communities. Peoples of the wider Ohlone cultural region used fish, shellfish, game, acorns and other plants, and coastal paths linked different environments through seasonal movement. In the late eighteenth century Spanish colonisation established Monterey as an administrative and military centre. Missions and presidios brought new institutions and demands on Indigenous labour, while ships linked California with other parts of the Spanish Pacific. After Mexican independence, maritime trade continued, including the exchange of hides. Indigenous communities faced disease, displacement and profound changes in land use.
simp_chinese: 蒙特雷海岸位于加利福尼亚中部，海湾、外海和内陆河谷为原住民社群提供多样资源。更广大的奥隆尼文化地区的人们利用鱼类、贝类、猎物、橡实和其他植物；沿岸道路则使不同环境通过季节性移动相连。十八世纪后期，西班牙殖民将蒙特雷建为行政和军事中心。传教站与驻防营地带来新机构及对原住民劳力的要求，船只则将加利福尼亚同西属太平洋其他地区相连。墨西哥独立后海上贸易继续，包括皮革交换。原住民社群面临疾病、迁移及土地利用的深刻变化。

english: Monterrey stands in the Verín district of southern Galicia, near the routes leading toward Portugal. Its position made the town a place of strategic concern to the Castilian crown. At the Cortes of Zamora in 1301, the procurators called Monterrey the key to the kingdom of Galicia and asked Ferdinand IV not to grant it away, so that royal jurisdiction would not be diminished. The name of the later city of Monterrey in Mexico commemorates a count of Monterrey, Gaspar de Zúñiga y Acevedo.
simp_chinese: 蒙特雷位于加利西亚南部的贝林地区，靠近通往葡萄牙的道路。这一位置使它成为卡斯蒂利亚王室关心的战略要地。1301年萨莫拉等级会议上，代表们称蒙特雷为加利西亚王国的钥匙，请求费尔南多四世不要将它赐给他人，以免王室辖权受到削弱。后来墨西哥的蒙特雷城以蒙特雷伯爵加斯帕尔·德苏尼加-阿塞维多的头衔命名。

english:
Montes Claros stands in the northern backlands of Minas Gerais, amid hills and valleys that drain toward the São Francisco. The settlement grew from a cattle estate established on lands granted to Antônio Gonçalves Figueira in 1707. Its name, “clear hills,” recalled the surrounding landscape, while Formigas referred to a stream near the original settlement.

Figueira had taken part in expeditions into the interior before receiving his grant. Cattle raising formed an important part of the occupation of the northern sertão, and a community developed around the estate and its chapel. Known as Montes Claros de Formigas, the settlement became a parish in the eighteenth century and was raised to a town in 1831. Its position brought together the routes of the inland cattle country and the valleys leading toward the São Francisco.
simp_chinese:
蒙特斯克拉鲁斯坐落在米纳斯吉拉斯北部腹地，四周丘陵与河谷的水流最终汇入圣弗朗西斯科河。1707年，安东尼奥·贡萨尔维斯·菲盖拉获赐此地，建立牧牛庄园，聚落便由此发展起来。“蒙特斯克拉鲁斯”意为“明亮的群山”，得名于周围景观；福尔米加斯则是一条附近溪流的名字。

菲盖拉曾参加深入内陆的探险，后来获得了这片土地。养牛业是北部腹地殖民活动的重要组成部分，一处社区在庄园和小教堂周围逐渐形成。聚落称为蒙特斯克拉鲁斯·迪福尔米加斯，十八世纪成为堂区，1831年升格为镇。这里汇聚了内陆牧牛地带的道路，以及通往圣弗朗西斯科河谷的路线。

english: Monflanquin is a hilltop bastide overlooking the Lède valley. Founded by Alphonse of Poitiers in 1256, its regular streets and plots were laid out around a central square, expressing the ordered plan of a new medieval town. During the Wars of Religion it became a prize for armed factions. In 1574 Protestant forces under the lords of Langoiran and Vivans captured the town and took numerous nobles prisoner.
simp_chinese: 蒙弗朗坎是一座俯瞰莱德河谷的山顶新城。普瓦捷的阿方斯于1256年建立此城，整齐的街道和地块围绕中央广场展开，体现了中世纪新建城镇的规划。宗教战争期间，这里成为各派争夺的目标。1574年，朗瓜朗领主与维旺领主率领新教军队攻占城镇，俘获了众多贵族。

english: Montgomery Castle stands on a rocky spur above a small town near the Welsh border. Henry III began the stone fortress in 1223 as a defence against the growing power of Llywelyn the Great. In 1267 the Treaty of Montgomery recognised Llywelyn ap Gruffudd as Prince of Wales, giving the place a role in negotiations as well as war. The castle was surrendered to Parliament in 1644 during the Civil War. A battle on the plain below followed as Royalist forces attempted to recover it. Parliament ordered the fortress demolished in 1649, leaving low walls and ruined towers above the town.
simp_chinese: 蒙哥马利城堡坐落在威尔士边境小镇上方的岩石山嘴。亨利三世于1223年开始修建石堡，以防御势力日增的“大帝”卢埃林。1267年，《蒙哥马利条约》承认卢埃林·阿普·格里菲兹为威尔士亲王，使此地既是战争场所，也是谈判之地。英国内战期间，城堡于1644年向议会派投降。王党军队试图夺回城堡，随后在下方平原爆发战斗。议会于1649年下令拆毁要塞，镇上方只留下低矮墙体和破败塔楼。

english: Monthey lies in the lower Valais near the Rhône valley and the route toward Lake Geneva. It was a Savoyard châtellenie until 1536, when the Valais dizains took control of the lower valley. After a dispute in 1546, they seized the castle, which became the governor's residence. The castle and part of the town burned in 1606; Governor Antoine Waldin had it rebuilt in 1607. Monthey remained subject to the Valais dizains until 1798, when the old regime ended. Later political changes brought it into the Helvetic Republic, the Republic of Valais and, for a time, the French department of Simplon. A glassworks founded in 1821 marked the development of new manufactures alongside older valley occupations.
simp_chinese: 蒙泰位于下瓦莱，靠近罗讷河谷和通往日内瓦湖的道路。1536年以前，这里是萨伏依的城堡辖区；此后瓦莱诸区控制了下河谷。1546年一场争执后，诸区接收城堡，将其作为总督驻地。1606年，城堡与部分城镇遭火焚毁，总督安托万·瓦尔丹于次年主持重建。蒙泰直到1798年旧制度结束才摆脱瓦莱诸区的统治。随后的政治变动使它先后进入赫尔维蒂共和国、瓦莱共和国，并一度属于法国的辛普朗省。1821年建立的玻璃厂，则显示传统河谷生计之外出现了新的制造业。

english: Montiel lies beneath the Castle of the Star in the uplands of La Mancha. The fortress belonged to the Order of Santiago and became the setting for a struggle that changed the Castilian dynasty. In March 1369 King Peter I took refuge there during his war against his half-brother Henry of Trastámara. After the battle of Montiel the rivals met, and Henry killed Peter. The death of the king secured the throne for the House of Trastámara.
simp_chinese: 蒙铁尔位于拉曼恰高地，星堡俯瞰镇子。这座属于圣地亚哥骑士团的要塞成为改变卡斯蒂利亚王朝的斗争舞台。1369年3月，国王佩德罗一世在与同父异母兄弟特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克交战时退入城堡。蒙铁尔战役之后，两个对手相见，恩里克杀死佩德罗。国王之死为特拉斯塔马拉家族确保了王位。

english:
The Gulf of Montijo belongs to Panama's Pacific coast, where tidal waters, mangroves, river mouths, and islands create a productive maritime environment. Indigenous communities used fishing, shellfish, cultivated foods, and forest resources, with canoes linking shores and inland waterways. Tides and shallow channels required local knowledge, while sheltered places offered opportunities for landing and exchange. The relationship between river and sea connected coastal resources with products from the interior.

Spanish expansion during the sixteenth century transformed the wider Veraguas region through settlement, missions, labor demands, and attempts to control mineral wealth. Indigenous communities faced disease and coercion while maintaining or adapting their own institutions. Coastal navigation supplied small settlements and connected them with larger Pacific routes, though some places remained distant from strong official supervision. Farmers, fishers, boatmen, and traders sustained daily life through changes in authority.
simp_chinese:
蒙蒂霍湾属于巴拿马太平洋岸，潮汐水域、红树林、河口和岛屿构成富有资源的海洋环境。原住民利用捕鱼、贝类、耕作食物及林产，独木舟联系岸线和内陆水道。潮汐、浅水航道要求地方知识，遮蔽地点提供登陆和交换机会。河海相接使海岸资源同腹地产品流通，也让不同社群能够维持社会关系与日常供应。

十六世纪，西班牙的扩张通过定居、传教、劳力要求和控制矿产的尝试，改变了更广阔的韦拉瓜斯地区。原住民面对疾病与强迫，同时维持或调整自身制度。沿海航行供应小型居民点，并将它们接入较大的太平洋航路；一些地方仍远离有力的官方监督。农民、渔民、船工和商人在权力变化中维持日常生活。

english: Montlaur lies in the high country of Vivarais near Coucouron, where a castle gave its name to a family of lords. Their barony formed one of the important noble jurisdictions of the province. Its title carried a place among the barons who represented Vivarais at the Estates of Languedoc; in 1748 the Marquis de Vogüé was admitted in that capacity for Montlaur. The mountain seat gave its name to a lordship whose influence extended beyond the uplands.
simp_chinese: 蒙洛尔位于维瓦赖库库龙附近的高地，一座城堡为当地领主家族留下了名字。他们的男爵领是本省重要的贵族辖地之一。男爵称号赋予持有人代表维瓦赖参加朗格多克等级会议的地位；1748年，沃居埃侯爵以蒙洛尔男爵的身份获准出席。这个山地据点为影响延伸至高地之外的领地留下了名字。

english: Montluçon stands beside the Cher beneath the castle of the dukes of Bourbon. A fortress occupied the height by the thirteenth century; Duke Louis II rebuilt part of it and died here in 1410. The castle later passed to the French crown after Francis I seized the possessions of Charles III, Constable of Bourbon, in 1523. Its position above the old town recalls the power of the family whose lands once embraced much of this region.
simp_chinese: 蒙吕松坐落在谢尔河畔，波旁公爵的城堡俯瞰着城镇。十三世纪时，高地上已有堡垒；路易二世公爵重建了其中一部分，并于1410年在此去世。1523年，弗朗索瓦一世没收波旁的统帅夏尔三世的财产，城堡后来转入法国王室手中。它高踞旧城上方，令人想起这个家族曾在本地区拥有的广大领地。

sources.title: Château des ducs de Bourbon à Montluçon

english: Montmédy occupies a height above the Chiers valley, a strong position on the frontier of Luxembourg. The town was sold to the duke of Luxembourg in 1364 and later passed through Burgundian to Habsburg rule. From 1545 Emperor Charles V replaced its medieval castle with bastioned defences suited to artillery. In 1657 French forces besieged the Spanish stronghold; the young engineer Vauban took part and was wounded. The Treaty of the Pyrenees assigned Montmédy to France in 1659, after which Vauban strengthened its fortifications.
simp_chinese: 蒙梅迪占据谢尔河谷上方的高地，是卢森堡边境的一处坚固据点。1364年，城镇被售予卢森堡公爵，后来先后归勃艮第和哈布斯堡家族统治。1545年起，皇帝查理五世以适应火炮战争的棱堡防线取代中世纪城堡。1657年，法军围攻这座西班牙要塞，年轻的工程师沃邦参与并受伤。1659年比利牛斯条约将蒙梅迪交给法国，沃邦随后加强了其防御工事。

english:
Montmorency gave its name to one of the great noble families of France, whose lords held a medieval castle above the valley to the north of Paris. Their collegiate church of Saint-Martin served as a family burial chapel, and its stained glass recorded the lineage and piety of its noble patrons over generations.

Guillaume de Montmorency began rebuilding the church in 1515, constructing the choir and the first four bays before work stopped around 1530. His son Anne, constable of France, completed the nave between 1557 and 1563. The collegiate church became a memorial to the family as well as a place of worship, housing the constable’s imposing tomb. In 1687 the Oratorians added a new façade, leaving another mark on a building shaped over generations.
simp_chinese:
蒙莫朗西为法国一个显赫贵族家族提供了名字，其领主的城堡俯瞰巴黎以北的河谷。家族的圣马丁同修教堂兼作墓葬礼拜堂，彩色玻璃记录了赞助者的世系与信仰。

纪尧姆·德·蒙莫朗西于1515年开始重建教堂，修筑唱诗席及最初四跨，工程约于1530年暂停。他的儿子、法国王室统帅安纳于1557年至1563年完成中殿。教堂既是礼拜场所，也是家族纪念之地，安纳的宏伟陵墓 位于其中。1687年，耶稣圣堂会修士增建新立面，为这座历代建成的建筑留下另一处印记。

english:
Montmorillon stands on the Gartempe in eastern Poitou, where river crossings and roads connect a market settlement with agricultural and wooded countryside. Farming, livestock and local crafts supply the town, while services and exchange draw people from surrounding villages. The river provides water and a line of movement, though floods and seasonal conditions can affect the practical use of its banks. Religious institutions add a strong cultural presence to the urban landscape.

Montmorillon grew around the church of Notre-Dame and a castle guarding the Gartempe crossing. Its Maison-Dieu received pilgrims and the sick; among its buildings is the twelfth-century octagonal funerary chapel, built above an ossuary. The chapel's damaged roof was renewed between 1611 and 1639. These institutions gave the town a religious and charitable role beyond its immediate market.
simp_chinese:
蒙莫里永位于普瓦图东部加尔唐普河畔，渡口和道路把市镇同农业林地乡村连接。耕作、牲畜及地方手工业供应城镇，服务和交换吸引周边村民。河流提供水及交通线，洪水和季节条件影响岸边实际利用。宗教机构为城市景观增加强文化存在。

蒙莫里永围绕圣母教堂及守卫加尔唐普河渡口的城堡发展。当地济贫院接待朝圣者和病人，其建筑包括一座十二世纪八角墓地礼拜堂，建在藏骨所之上。受损的礼拜堂屋顶在1611至1639年间得到修复。这些机构赋予城镇超出地方市场范围的宗教与慈善作用。

english:
Montpellier grew up a few miles inland from the Mediterranean, after pirate raids drove people away from the episcopal town of Maguelone. Its name is medieval Latin for “Woad Mountain”, from the blue dye prepared here, and the lords of the Guilhem family walled the town around the year 1000. In 1204 Marie of Montpellier brought it to Peter II of Aragon as her dowry, and under the Aragonese it became the kingdom's centre of the spice trade, with some 40,000 people before the Black Death. In 1220 Cardinal Conrad of Urach gave statutes to the medical masters, and the school drew students such as Rabelais and Nostradamus.

James III of Majorca, in need of money against Peter IV of Aragon, sold the city to Philip VI of France in 1349, and it became part of Languedoc. Jacques Cœur made it a base for his trade from 1432, and when the bishop moved here from Maguelone in 1536 the monastery church of Saint Peter became the cathedral. Protestants took control in 1562, and in 1593 Henry IV founded the university botanical garden at the suggestion of Pierre Richer de Belleval. As one of the Huguenot places of surety, the city was besieged by Louis XIII in 1622, and its walls were ordered down and a royal citadel built.
simp_chinese:
蒙彼利埃兴起于离地中海几英里的内陆，起因是海盗袭扰迫使人们离开主教城镇马格洛讷。地名在中世纪拉丁语里意为“菘蓝山”，得自当地制作的蓝色染料；吉耶姆家族的领主在公元1000年前后为小镇筑起城墙。1204年，玛丽·德·蒙彼利埃把此城作为嫁妆带给阿拉贡的佩德罗二世，在阿拉贡治下，它成为王国香料贸易的中心，黑死病前有约四万居民。1220年，乌拉赫的康拉德枢机为医学教师们订立章程，这所医学院后来吸引了拉伯雷、诺查丹玛斯等学生。

1349年，马略卡的海梅三世为与阿拉贡的佩德罗四世作战筹款，把此城卖给法王腓力六世，蒙彼利埃从此隶属朗格多克。雅克·克尔自1432年起在此设立贸易据点；1536年主教从马格洛讷迁来，圣彼得修道院教堂改为主教座堂。1562年新教徒控制了城市，1593年亨利四世采纳皮埃尔·里谢·德·贝勒瓦尔的建议创立大学植物园。作为胡格诺派的保障城市之一，蒙彼利埃于1622年被路易十三围攻，城防被下令拆除，并修建了王家城堡。

english: Montreal Lake lies among the forests and wetlands south of Lac la Ronge. From O'Connor Bay at its northern end, the Montreal River flows towards the larger lake and the Churchill River system. The lake also sends water south by the Bittern River. Its waters support fish including northern pike, walleye, lake whitefish and burbot, while rivers from the surrounding wooded country enter along its shores.
simp_chinese: 蒙特利尔湖位于拉龙日湖南方的森林与湿地之间。蒙特利尔河从湖泊北端的奥康纳湾流出，通往拉龙日湖和丘吉尔河水系；比特恩河则从南端流出。周围林地的河流汇入湖中，水里生活着北梭鱼、玻璃梭鲈、湖白鲑和江鳕等鱼类。

english:
Montreuil stands on a rocky height above the Canche estuary. In the Middle Ages its harbour offered the French royal domain an opening to the sea; before 1204 it was the royal domain’s only port, and the town was protected by walls and a royal castle. Its position near the English and Habsburg frontiers later made its defences especially valuable.

The army of Charles V ravaged Montreuil in 1537. Francis I strengthened the town with bastioned walls, which helped it resist an Anglo-imperial attack in 1544. Later, Charles IX ordered a new star-shaped citadel built around part of the old medieval royal castle itself. Its five irregular bastions were carefully fitted to the shape of the ground; Vauban reinforced the site again around 1670.
simp_chinese:
蒙特勒伊位于康什河口上方的岩石高地。中世纪时，这里的港口为法国王领提供通向大海的出口，1204年以前更是王领唯一的港口；城镇受到城墙和王室城堡的保护。它靠近英格兰与哈布斯堡的边境，后来使防御工事尤其重要。

1537年，查理五世的军队蹂躏蒙特勒伊。弗朗索瓦一世以棱堡式城墙加强防御，帮助城镇在1544年抵御英帝联军。此后，查理九世下令围绕旧王室城堡的一部分修建新堡垒。五座棱堡顺应地形布置；约1670年，沃邦再次加强了这里的防御。

english: Montreuillon lies on the upper Yonne in the wooded Morvan. Its river became part of the great trade in firewood for Paris: logs cut in the forests were released into streams and carried downstream to Clamecy, where they were assembled into rafts. A company of local merchants formed in 1763 organized transport from the Morvan ponds to the Yonne. Its river keeper at Montreuillon supervised marked timber, cleared obstructions and saw that damaged waterworks were repaired after a float.
simp_chinese: 蒙特勒永位于林木繁茂的莫尔旺、约讷河上游。河流曾是巴黎薪柴贸易的重要一环：森林中砍伐的木段投入溪流，顺水运至克拉姆西，在那里扎成木筏。1763年成立的地方商人公司组织木材从莫尔旺池塘运往约讷河。驻蒙特勒永的河务管理员负责监督标记过的木材、清除堵塞，并确保放木后修复受损水利设施。

english:
Montreux lies on the northeastern shore of Lake Geneva, beneath slopes that became a wine-growing region from the twelfth century. In Roman times roads from Italy divided here towards Aventicum and Gaul. The name of Montreux derives from a small monastery established by the eleventh century. In 1295 the bishop of Sion sold the parish to Girard of Oron.

In 1317 the parish was divided between the lords of Oron and the counts of Savoy. A Brotherhood of the Holy Spirit administered estates and a hospital from about 1309. Bernese rule from 1536 brought Montreux within the bailiwick of Chillon and introduced the Reformation. Protestant refugees from Italy settled in the region and established workshops. Bern's rule ended in 1798 when French forces took the country.
simp_chinese:
蒙特勒位于日内瓦湖东北岸，十二世纪起湖畔山坡发展为葡萄种植区。罗马时代，来自意大利的道路在此分岔，分别通向阿文蒂库姆和高卢。蒙特勒之名源自一座至迟十一世纪便已存在的小修道院。1295年，锡永主教将当地教区卖给奥龙的吉拉尔。

1317年，教区由奥龙领主与萨伏依伯爵分治。约1309年起，圣神兄弟会管理当地地产和医院。1536年伯尔尼统治开始后，蒙特勒归西庸辖区管辖，并接受宗教改革。来自意大利的新教难民在这一地区定居，建立作坊。1798年，法国军队夺取该地区，伯尔尼的统治随之结束。

english: The Monxoró were an Indigenous community associated with the river and settlement later known as Mossoró in northeastern Brazil. Accounts place them along the river in a region of dry interior plains leading toward the Atlantic. Their name was preserved in that of the river and the town that grew beside it, a reminder of the Indigenous inhabitants of the country before colonial settlement.
simp_chinese: 蒙肖罗人是与巴西东北部后来称为莫索罗的河流和聚落相联系的原住民社区。记载将他们置于河畔，附近是通向大西洋的干旱内陆平原。他们的名称保留在河流及沿河发展的城镇名称中，提醒后人这里在殖民定居之前已有原住民居住。

english:
Monza stands on the Lambro north of Milan. In the Lombard era Queen Theodelinda established a royal residence here and founded a church that grew into the cathedral. Its treasury holds the Iron Crown, long and closely associated with the coronation of kings of Italy. The medieval Arengario, built for civic government, stands as a counterpart to the cathedral.

Theodelinda's remains were transferred to a chapel in the cathedral in 1308. In the fifteenth century the Zavattari brothers adorned the chapel with a cycle of frescoes telling the queen's story. Monza meanwhile remained closely linked to Milan, passing under Visconti authority after struggles between the great Milanese families. The church and its treasury continued to preserve the memory of Lombard kingship.
simp_chinese:
蒙扎位于米兰以北的兰布罗河畔。伦巴第时期，王后特奥多琳达在此建立王室居所，创立的教堂后来发展为主教座堂。教堂宝库中保存着铁王冠，长期与意大利国王的加冕相联系。为城市政府修建的中世纪市政厅则与主教座堂遥相呼应。

1308年，特奥多琳达的遗骸迁入主教座堂内献给她的礼拜堂。十五世纪，扎瓦塔里兄弟以一组讲述王后故事的壁画装饰礼拜堂。与此同时，蒙扎与米兰保持密切联系，在米兰大家族争斗之后归于维斯孔蒂家族的权力之下。教堂和宝库继续保存着伦巴第王权的记忆。

english: Monze is associated with a rainmaking shrine in the country of the Tonga. The name belongs to a line of ritual leaders whose authority reached beyond their immediate neighbours, drawing people to seek rain at the shrine. Tonga communities lived across the plateau and valleys of the Zambezi country, maintaining local traditions of spiritual authority and appeals for rain.
simp_chinese: 蒙泽与汤加人地区的一处求雨圣地相联系。这一名称属于一系列仪式领袖，他们的声望超出近邻，吸引人们前来圣地祈雨。汤加社群居住在赞比西地区的高原与河谷之间，保有地方性的宗教权威和祈雨传统。

english:
Monzón stands beside the Cinca beneath a castle held by the Templars from 1143. The future James I of Aragon was educated in their care. The knights surrendered the fortress in 1309 during the suppression of their order; their former lands later passed to the Hospitallers.

The church of Santa María del Romeral hosted the Cortes of the kingdom and the general Cortes of the Crown of Aragon from the thirteenth to seventeenth centuries. Representatives gathered there to discuss war, peace, finance and law.
simp_chinese:
蒙松坐落在辛卡河畔，城堡自1143年起由圣殿骑士团掌管。未来的阿拉贡国王海梅一世曾在骑士团照料下接受教育。骑士团遭取缔时，骑士们于1309年交出要塞；其旧领地后来转交医院骑士团。

十三至十七世纪，圣玛丽亚德尔罗梅拉尔教堂接待王国议会及阿拉贡王冠领地联合议会。代表们在此讨论战争、和平、财政与法律。

english: Monzón de Campos lies near the Carrión beneath a castle that dominates the surrounding plain. Once the centre of an early medieval county, it later became a noble lordship. In 1351 Peter I granted the town, fortress and dependent lands to Sancho Sánchez de Rojas, together with their rents and jurisdiction. During the Revolt of the Comuneros the castle was occupied by the forces of Antonio de Acuña, Bishop of Zamora, as the uprising spread through Tierra de Campos.
simp_chinese: 蒙松德坎波斯位于卡里翁河附近，城堡俯瞰周围平原。这里曾是中世纪早期伯国的中心，后来成为贵族领地。1351年，佩德罗一世将城镇、堡垒和属地连同租税与司法权赐给桑乔·桑切斯·德罗哈斯。卡斯蒂利亚公社起义蔓延至坎波斯地区时，萨莫拉主教安东尼奥·德阿库尼亚的军队占领了城堡。

english: The Mooi River crosses the highveld before joining the Vaal. Springs in the dolomitic country along its course feed its waters and those of the Wonderfonteinspruit, one of its tributaries. By the early nineteenth century the land north of the Vaal was home to Sotho-Tswana communities. To the west lay the country of the Barolong, while Kwena and Hurutshe chiefdoms held lands farther north around the Magaliesberg and the upper rivers beyond it.
simp_chinese: 穆伊河穿过高地草原，最终汇入瓦尔河。沿途白云岩地区的泉水补给着河流及其支流旺德方丹溪。到19世纪初，瓦尔河以北生活着索托—茨瓦纳诸社群。西面是巴罗隆人的土地，宽纳与胡鲁采人的酋邦则分布在更北方的马加利斯山及其另一侧的河流上游。

english: Moona Mpanda lies near Mambilima, where the Luapula tumbles through a series of rapids. Below the falls the valley opens into marshes and floodplains leading to Lake Mweru. Fishers near the rapids used dams, weirs and traps to catch fish before the floodwaters receded.
simp_chinese: 穆纳姆潘达靠近曼比利马，卢阿普拉河在这里流过一连串急流。瀑布下游的河谷展开为沼泽和洪泛平原，通向姆韦鲁湖。急流附近的渔民利用堤坝、拦鱼堰和鱼笼，在洪水退去前捕鱼。

english:
Moʻorea is a mountainous volcanic island just across the sea west of Tahiti, surrounded by a reef and lagoon. Cook and Opunohu bays cut into the northern coast beneath steep ridges, and Polynesian communities cultivated the valleys below the peaks. The island’s chiefs maintained close ties and rivalries with Tahiti and the Leeward Islands.

Pōmare II sought refuge on Moʻorea in 1808 after a coalition of Tahitian rivals opposed him. From there he returned to Tahiti with allies in 1815 and defeated Opuhara at Feʻi Pī. Christian missions gained influence during this period, and a printing press was established at ʻĀfareaitu on Moʻorea in 1817. Two years later Pōmare promulgated a new written code of laws for his kingdom.
simp_chinese:
莫雷阿是与塔希提隔海相望的西方多山火山岛，周围环绕礁盘与潟湖。库克湾和奥普诺胡湾切入北岸，背后是陡峭山脊；波利尼西亚社群耕种山峰下的山谷。岛上首领与塔希提及背风群岛维持密切联系，也存在竞争。

1808年，波马雷二世受到塔希提对手联盟的反对，前往莫雷阿避难。1815年，他从此率盟友返回塔希提，在费伊皮击败奥普哈拉。这一时期基督教传教团的影响日增，1817年莫雷阿的阿法雷艾图建立了印刷所。两年后，波马雷为王国颁布了新的成文法典。

english: A coral reef surrounds Moʻorea, enclosing a lagoon around its mountainous volcanic island. The sea lanes between Moʻorea and Tahiti carried chiefs, families and warriors. In 1808 Pōmare II took refuge on Moʻorea; in 1815 he crossed back to Tahiti with allies and defeated his rivals at Feʻi Pī.
simp_chinese: 珊瑚礁环绕莫雷阿多山的火山岛，礁内是一片潟湖。莫雷阿与塔希提之间的海路运送首领、家族和战士。1808年，波马雷二世在莫雷阿避难；1815年，他与盟友渡海返回塔希提，在费伊皮击败对手。

english: Moʻorea is a high volcanic island west of Tahiti, its mountainous shore fringed by coral reef. Polynesian communities lived here long before European expeditions arrived. In 1769 Joseph Banks went ashore on Moʻorea during James Cook’s first Pacific voyage and met no opposition.
simp_chinese: 莫雷阿是塔希提以西的一座高耸火山岛，山地海岸外缘有珊瑚礁。欧洲探险队到来之前，波利尼西亚社群早已在岛上生活。1769年，约瑟夫·班克斯在詹姆斯·库克第一次太平洋航行期间登上莫雷阿，没有遭到抵抗。

english: The Moose River descends through the Rocky Mountains to meet the upper Fraser just above Moose Lake. The Fraser then flows through the lake and westward beneath towering peaks. In the early nineteenth century, fur hunters and guides crossed the mountains toward the upper Fraser; among them was Pierre Hatsinaton, an Iroquois guide known as Tête Jaune, who led a Hudson's Bay Company party to the river's forks.
simp_chinese: 驼鹿河从落基山脉流下，在驼鹿湖上游不远处汇入弗雷泽河。弗雷泽河穿过湖泊后，在高耸山峰之下向西流去。19世纪初，毛皮猎人和向导翻越山脉前往弗雷泽河上游；其中一位易洛魁向导皮埃尔·哈齐纳顿，人称“黄头”，曾带领哈德逊湾公司的人马到达河流的分叉处。

english: Moosehead Lake lies among the forested mountains of northern Maine and is the source of the Kennebec River. More than eighty islands dot its cold waters. On its eastern shore, the cliffs of Mount Kineo rise sharply above the lake; Indigenous people came from afar to obtain the mountain's rhyolite for stone tools. The surrounding country contains headwaters of the Penobscot, Piscataquis and Saint John rivers as well as the Kennebec.
simp_chinese: 穆斯黑德湖位于缅因北部森林山地之间，是肯尼贝克河的源头。八十余座岛屿散布在冰冷的湖水中。东岸的基尼奥山峭壁从湖边拔起，原住民曾从远方来到这里，采集山上的流纹岩制作石器。湖泊周围还分布着佩诺布斯科特河、皮斯卡塔奎斯河与圣约翰河的源流。

english:
At the mouth of the Moose River, the waters of the interior reach the south-western corner of James Bay. This is the homeland of the Moose Cree, whose journeys followed the rivers between forest and coast. In 1673 the Hudson's Bay Company established Moose Fort here, depending on Cree knowledge, hospitality and trade to sustain its post.

French forces captured the fort in 1686 during the struggle for the bay's fur trade. Although the region was ceded to Britain by the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713, the company did not re-establish the post until 1730. Cree traders had sought its return, since the journey to other posts could be dangerous. After the rival fur companies joined in 1821, Moose Factory became a supply centre for inland posts as far as the Ottawa River watershed.
simp_chinese:
穆斯河在这里注入詹姆斯湾西南角，将内陆水域带向大海。这是穆斯克里人的家园，人们沿河往来森林与海岸。1673年，哈得孙湾公司在此建立穆斯堡，贸易站依靠克里人的知识、款待和交易维持。

1686年，法国军队在争夺海湾毛皮贸易时攻占了堡垒。尽管1713年《乌得勒支条约》将这一地区割让给英国，公司直到1730年才重建据点。克里商人曾希望贸易站恢复，因为前往其他据点的路途可能危险。1821年两家竞争的毛皮公司合并后，穆斯贸易站成为内陆据点的补给中心，服务范围远及渥太华河流域。

english: Mootka recalls Motka and the Motovsky Sámi district of the northern Kola coast. The name appears on a map of 1595, while the Motovskaya inlet lies along the Barents Sea shore. Records of 1608 counted Sámi inhabitants in the Motovsky, Pechenga and Pazreka districts. Fishing and reindeer herding supported communities whose lands extended between the coast and the peninsula's inland lakes and forests.
simp_chinese: 莫特卡指向科拉半岛北岸的莫特卡及莫托夫斯基萨米地区。1595年的地图已标出这一地名，莫托夫斯卡亚湾则位于巴伦支海岸。1608年的记录统计了莫托夫斯基、佩琴加和帕兹列卡地区的萨米居民。捕鱼和饲养驯鹿支持着这些社群，土地从海岸延伸至半岛内陆的湖泊与森林。

english:
Mopeia belongs to the lower Zambezi country, where a great river, seasonal floodplains and adjoining woodland supported communities with varied livelihoods. Cultivation could use fertile ground renewed by floods, while fishing and the collection of local products added to household resources. Boats linked settlements and carried goods through a landscape where water could be both a route and a barrier. Seasonal changes required careful judgement about fields, crossings and the location of safe ground.

In the wider Zambezi valley, Portuguese traders established posts at Sena and Quelimane in the sixteenth century. Crown land grants called prazos became part of the Portuguese presence, though authority depended on African communities and intermediaries. In the eighteenth century caravans carried ivory and other goods through the region in exchange for textiles and beads; from the late century, enslaved people also became an increasingly important commodity. These are regional developments rather than a documented account of Mopeia itself.
simp_chinese:
莫佩亚属于赞比西河下游，大河、季节泛滥平原和邻近林地支撑多样生计。耕作利用洪水更新的肥沃土地，捕鱼及采集地方物产补充家庭资源。舟船联系聚落并运输货物，在这里水面既能成为道路，也可能构成障碍。季节变化要求居民谨慎判断田地、渡口和安全地面的位置。

在更广阔的赞比西河谷，葡萄牙商人于16世纪在塞纳和克利马内设立商站。称为普拉佐的王室土地授予制度成为葡萄牙势力的一部分，但其权威仍依赖非洲社群和中间人。18世纪，商队在这一地区运输象牙等货物，交换布匹和珠饰；从世纪末起，被奴役的人也逐渐成为重要的交易对象。这些是区域历史，而非已有记载的莫佩亚地方史。

english: The Moqoit, also known as Mocoví, are a Guaycuruan-speaking people of the Gran Chaco. Traditionally they hunted and gathered across a broad country of forest and grassland, moving as resources changed with the seasons. The adoption of horses transformed movement and warfare on the plains. In the eighteenth century Jesuit missionaries founded settlements among Mocoví communities, including San Javier on the Paraná River in 1743.
simp_chinese: 莫科伊特人也称莫科维人，是大查科使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言的民族。传统上，他们在广阔的森林和草原地区狩猎采集，随着季节资源变化而迁徙。马匹的使用改变了平原上的移动和战争。十八世纪，耶稣会士在莫科维社群中建立传教聚落，其中包括1743年建于巴拉那河畔的圣哈维尔。

english:
Mora lies at the northern end of Lake Siljan, where the waters of the Österdalälven meet the lake. Farms and villages around the shore formed a community with strong local traditions. In the winter of 1520–21 the fugitive Gustav Eriksson, later known as Gustav Vasa, came to Dalarna seeking support against King Christian II.

Tradition places Gustav's appeal to the people of Mora by the church. His journey through Dalarna became surrounded by stories of pursuit and rescue, though their details cannot all be established. Support gathered in the province helped launch the rebellion that brought him to the Swedish throne. Relations with the new king were not always peaceful: in 1525 Mora's priest Jakob Persson joined opposition to Gustav and fled to Norway after being removed from office.
simp_chinese:
穆拉位于锡利扬湖北端，东达尔河在此注入湖中。湖岸的农场和村庄组成拥有深厚地方传统的社群。1520至1521年冬，流亡中的古斯塔夫·埃里克松，也就是后来的古斯塔夫·瓦萨，来到达拉纳寻求支持，以反抗克里斯蒂安二世。

传统记述称古斯塔夫在穆拉教堂旁向居民呼吁。他穿越达拉纳的旅程后来被追捕和营救的故事环绕，具体细节并非都能证实。当地集结的支持帮助发动了使他登上瑞典王位的起义。然而与新国王的关系并不总是和平：1525年，穆拉牧师雅各布·佩尔松参与反对古斯塔夫，被免职后逃往挪威。

english: Mora lies at the foot of the Mandara Mountains, in the country of the Wandala kingdom. Its rulers governed from centres that included nearby Doulo, while the mountain and plain lay close to the domains of powerful Bornu. Around 1715 Mai Bukar Aji embraced Islam and Mandara became a sultanate. A century later Modibo Adama briefly captured Doulo during the Fulbe jihad, but a Mandara counterattack drove him out.
simp_chinese: 默拉位于曼达拉山脚下，处在万达拉王国的土地上。统治者曾从附近的杜洛等中心治国，山地与平原也毗邻强大的博尔努。约1715年，迈·布卡尔·阿吉接受伊斯兰教，曼达拉成为苏丹国。约一个世纪后，莫迪博·阿达马在富尔贝圣战中短暂占领杜洛，但曼达拉的反攻将他逐出境外。

english: Mora de Rubielos lies among the hills of southern Aragon, beneath the great castle of the Fernández de Heredia family. Both fortress and lordly palace, the Gothic building dominated the walled town and the surrounding lordship. The family also shaped its religious life: in 1454, through the influence of Juan Fernández de Heredia, the church of Santa María was raised to the rank of a collegiate church.
simp_chinese: 莫拉德鲁维耶洛斯坐落在阿拉贡南部丘陵中，费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚家族的宏大城堡高踞其上。这座哥特式建筑兼为要塞和领主宫邸，统领着有城墙环绕的城镇及周围领地。家族也影响了当地宗教生活：1454年，在胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚的推动下，圣玛丽亚教堂升为协同教堂。

english:
Mora was a Muslim region in the Afar plain east of the Awash, known to medieval writers alongside the neighbouring powers of Ifat and Adal. In the thirteenth century its ruler was defeated by Dilgamis of the Muslim sultanate of Shewa. During Emperor Amda Seyon's fourteenth-century campaigns, Mora joined a coalition with Adal against the Ethiopian ruler, with Imam Salih chosen to lead their forces.

The later city of Semera lies here.
simp_chinese:
抹拉是阿瓦什河以东阿法尔平原上的穆斯林地区，中世纪作家常将它与邻近的伊法特和阿达尔并提。十三世纪，抹拉统治者败于穆斯林绍阿苏丹国的迪尔加米斯。十四世纪皇帝阿姆达·塞永征战期间，抹拉与阿达尔结盟对抗埃塞俄比亚统治者，推举伊玛目萨利赫为联军领袖。

后来的塞梅拉即位于此地。

english: Mora lies in the Alentejo, amid a countryside marked by monuments far older than the Portuguese kingdom. The Anta de Pavia began as a Neolithic burial chamber and was converted into a chapel dedicated to Saint Denis in the early seventeenth century. A document of 1293 mentions an estate called Cabeça de Mora, an early record of the name. The municipality received a charter from Manuel I in 1519, giving the settlement a place in the network of local jurisdictions of the kingdom.
simp_chinese: 莫拉位于阿连特茹，周围乡间散布着比葡萄牙王国古老得多的遗迹。帕维亚巨石墓原是新石器时代的墓室，十七世纪初被改为献给圣迪尼什的小堂。1293年的文书提到名为卡贝萨德莫拉的庄园，是这一地名的早期记录。1519年，曼努埃尔一世授予市镇特许状，使聚落成为王国地方辖区网络的一部分。

english: Morąg arose where an Old Prussian settlement stood before the Teutonic conquest. The Order's commander Hermann von Oettingen granted the new town Chełmno law in 1327, and early settlers came from the Harz region. After Grunwald in 1410 the Polish–Lithuanian army took the town and castle without a fight, but war brought devastation again in 1414. Morąg joined the Prussian Confederation and supported Poland in the Thirteen Years' War; after 1466 it remained an Order fief under the Polish Crown.
simp_chinese: 莫龙格兴起于条顿骑士团征服前的一处古普鲁士聚落旧址。1327年，骑士团指挥官赫尔曼·冯·厄廷根授予新城海乌姆诺法，早期移民来自德意志的哈尔茨地区。1410年格伦瓦尔德战役后，波兰立陶宛军不战而占领城镇和城堡，但1414年的战争再次带来毁灭。莫龙格加入普鲁士同盟，在十三年战争中支持波兰；1466年后，它仍是骑士团在波兰王室宗主权下的封地。

english:
Moramanga lies in the Ankay country between Madagascar's central highlands and its forested eastern coast. The valley of the Mangoro is associated with the Bezanozano, whose homeland lay along routes connecting Imerina with the coast. The name Bezanozano refers to the many very small braids traditionally worn in the hair. Trade with European ships and coastal merchants enriched the region during the eighteenth century.

In the early nineteenth century the expanding Merina kingdom brought the Bezanozano under its authority. Their labour became important to the transport of goods between Antananarivo and the port of Toamasina. Carrying loads across the steep country between plateau and coast was demanding work, and the obligations imposed on the Bezanozano weighed heavily on their communities.
simp_chinese:
穆拉曼加位于马达加斯加中央高地与东岸森林之间的安凯地区。曼古鲁河谷与贝扎努扎努人相联系，他们的家园处在连接伊梅里纳和海岸的道路上。贝扎努扎努的名称与传统发式中众多的小辫有关。十八世纪，与欧洲船只及沿海商人的贸易使这一地区富裕起来。

十九世纪初，扩张中的梅里纳王国将贝扎努扎努人纳入统治。他们的劳动力对安塔那那利佛与图阿马西纳港之间的货物运输变得重要。在高原与海岸之间陡峭的地形中负重行走十分艰苦，强加于贝扎努扎努人的劳役令其社群承受沉重负担。

english: Morane is an isolated atoll at the southern edge of the Tuamotus, southwest of Maria Est. Coconut palms and pandanus grow on its low islets, which enclose a lagoon without a passage to the sea. In 1828 Captain Samuel Grimwood sighted the island from the Discoverer; it appeared on charts as Grimwood’s Island.
simp_chinese: 莫拉内是土阿莫土南缘一座孤立的环礁，位于东玛丽亚西南方。椰树和露兜树生长在低矮小岛上，岛屿围绕的潟湖没有通向大海的水道。1828年，塞缪尔·格里姆伍德船长在发现者号上望见此岛；海图上曾将其标作格里姆伍德岛。

english: Morane is an isolated coral atoll in the southeastern Tuamotu Islands. A ring of reef and low land surrounds its lagoon, separated by a long stretch of sea from neighbouring islands. These waters belong to the scattered maritime world of eastern Polynesia, crossed by Polynesian voyagers before European expeditions.
simp_chinese: 莫拉纳是土阿莫土群岛东南部一座孤立的珊瑚环礁。礁体和低地环绕潟湖，与邻近岛屿之间隔着漫长的海程。这片水域属于岛屿零散的东波利尼西亚海洋世界，早在欧洲探险队之前，波利尼西亚航海者便已穿行其间。

english: Morangi lay on the frontier between the Ahom and Kachari kingdoms in the country of the Doyang and Dhansiri rivers. During the reign of Suhungmung, Ahom armies pushed into this region and established a fortified position at Marangi. In 1531 Kachari forces sent by King Khunkhara attempted to drive them out, but were defeated. The Ahoms organised the acquired territory as a province under an officer known as the Marangi Khowa Gohain.
simp_chinese: 莫兰吉位于阿洪与卡恰尔王国的边境，处在多扬河和丹西里河地区。苏洪蒙在位时，阿洪军队向这一地区推进，在马兰吉建立设防据点。1531年，卡恰尔王昆卡拉派军试图将其驱逐，却遭到失败。阿洪将夺得的领土组织为一个省，由称为马兰吉·科瓦·戈汉的官员管理。

english: Moratau belongs to Goodenough Island, the westernmost of the D’Entrecasteaux Islands off eastern New Guinea. Its steep mountains rise behind a narrow coast, with Fergusson Island across the channel to the east. Morata is one of the names associated with communities on Goodenough, whose inhabitants speak several related Austronesian languages. Canoe routes connect the island to its neighbours across the surrounding seas.
simp_chinese: 莫拉陶位于古迪纳夫岛，这是新几内亚东部外海当特尔卡斯托群岛最西端的岛屿。陡峭山地从狭窄海岸后方升起，费格森岛在东面隔水道相望。莫拉塔是与古迪纳夫岛社群有关的名称之一，岛民使用数种相互关联的南岛语言。独木舟航路横渡周边海域，将此岛与邻岛相连。

english: The Moray Firth is a great inlet of the North Sea on Scotland's northeastern coast. Its wide outer waters narrow toward a series of inner firths, including those of Cromarty and Beauly, with Inverness near their western end. Harbours around the shores gave shelter to ships and served the communities of the Highlands and Moray. Fish were caught in the firth as well as at sea; fixed traps known as yairs were used in its inner waters, with records of their use dating at least to the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 马里湾是北海深入苏格兰东北海岸的宽阔海湾。外湾水域辽阔，向西逐渐收窄，分成克罗马蒂湾、比尤利湾等内湾，因弗内斯靠近其西端。沿岸港湾为船只提供避风处，也服务于高地和马里地区的居民。人们在外海及湾内捕鱼；内湾使用名为 yair 的固定鱼栅，其使用记录至少可追溯至十七世纪。

english: Mordovo grew on the right bank of the Bityug, in a district whose earlier woodland was associated with the Mordvin people. By 1724 the village was shown with a church on a map of Voronezh province. Its inhabitants included service people and #italic odnodvortsy#!, smallholding peasants descended from frontier servicemen. A 1782 record described Mordovo as a local administrative centre with around four thousand inhabitants. The river valley thus supported a substantial village in the lands south of Tambov.
simp_chinese: 莫尔多沃兴起于比秋格河右岸，这片地区早先的林地与莫尔多瓦人有关。1724年的沃罗涅日省地图已将村庄标作有教堂的聚落。居民中有服役人员和边疆军役人员后裔形成的小农群体。1782年的文书称莫尔多沃是当地行政中心，约有四千名居民。这条河谷因而养育了坦波夫以南的一座规模可观的村庄。

english: Morella rises in tiers around a steep rock crowned by a castle, its walls guarding a town at the meeting of routes between Valencia, Aragon and Catalonia. Its Gothic churches and arcaded streets reflect the prosperity and privileges of a leading inland town of the kingdom of Valencia. In 1414 Morella hosted a remarkable attempt to end the Western Schism. King Ferdinand I, Benedict XIII, known as Pope Luna, and the preacher Vincent Ferrer met at the Franciscan convent. Their discussions lasted more than fifty days but failed to resolve the dispute; Benedict later withdrew to Peñíscola, where he continued to claim the papacy.
simp_chinese: 莫雷利亚依山层层而上，陡峭岩峰由城堡加冕，城墙守护着瓦伦西亚、阿拉贡与加泰罗尼亚道路交汇处的城镇。哥特式教堂和拱廊街道反映了这座瓦伦西亚王国内陆重镇的繁荣与特权。1414年，莫雷利亚成为一次试图结束天主教会西方大分裂的重要会谈的地点。国王费尔南多一世、被称为“月亮教宗”的本笃十三世和传教士文森特·费雷尔在方济各会修道院相会。会谈持续五十余日，仍未解决争端；本笃后来退至佩尼斯科拉，继续宣称自己的教宗地位。

english: Morro Moreno rises above the Pacific near the southern end of the Mejillones Peninsula. Its rocky slopes overlook a coast shaped by the Humboldt Current and the arid mountains of the Atacama Desert. The headland was a conspicuous landmark for sailing vessels following the coast, while the surrounding waters supported fishing and marine life. Coastal fog helps sustain vegetation on parts of the otherwise dry heights.
simp_chinese: 莫雷诺山岬耸立在梅希约内斯半岛南端附近的太平洋海岸上。岩石坡地俯瞰着一片受洪堡洋流和阿塔卡马沙漠干旱山岭影响的海岸。这处岬角是沿岸帆船醒目的航行标志，周围海水则孕育渔业和海洋生物。海雾为原本干燥的高地部分区域提供水分，使植被得以生长。

english:
The coast of Moresby Island is cut by inlets and sheltered by the smaller islands of southern Haida Gwaii. Haida villages stood along these shores, among them T'aanu and K'uuna, known to visiting traders as Tanu and Skedans. Cedar houses faced the water, and canoes carried people between villages, fishing grounds and neighbouring coasts.

From the late 1780s, British and American vessels sought the sea otter pelts hunted by the Haida. Ships visited villages along eastern Moresby Island, exchanging goods prized by their hosts for furs destined for distant markets. Cumshewa Inlet took its English name from the Haida chief G'omshewah, whose name appears in traders' accounts from 1787. The trade brought wealth as well as profound changes, and the intense demand greatly reduced the sea otter population.
simp_chinese:
莫里斯比岛的海岸被众多海湾切入，南部海达瓜伊的小岛在外侧提供遮蔽。海达人的村落沿岸分布，其中包括塔努和库纳，来访商人分别称之为塔努和斯基丹斯。雪松木屋面向水域，独木舟载着人们往来于村落、渔场和邻近海岸。

十八世纪八十年代末起，英国和美国船只前来寻求海达人猎取的海獭皮。商船到访莫里斯比岛东岸村落，用当地人珍视的货物换取运往远方市场的皮毛。卡姆希瓦湾的英文名称来自海达酋长戈姆谢瓦，商人从1787年起在航海记录中提到他。贸易带来财富，也造成深刻变化，强烈需求使海獭数量大幅减少。

english: Moreton Bay lies behind a chain of large sand islands on the eastern Australian coast. Its channels, tidal flats and sheltered waters are part of Quandamooka country, home to Aboriginal communities with deep connections to the bay and its islands. In 1799 Matthew Flinders sailed the sloop Norfolk into the region and explored the shores and the Glass House Mountains.
simp_chinese: 摩顿湾位于澳大利亚东海岸一列大型沙岛背后。湾中的水道、潮滩与受庇护水域属于昆达穆卡人的土地，当地原住民社群与海湾及岛屿有着深厚联系。1799年，马修·弗林德斯乘诺福克号单桅帆船驶入这一地区，探索海岸与玻璃屋山。

english: Morgan Valley lies along the Weber River in the mountains east of the Great Salt Lake. Shoshone and Ute people knew the river valleys and mountain approaches long before the arrival of fur trappers. In the 1820s British and American parties entered the country in search of beaver. Competition came to a head near Mountain Green in 1825, when men from Peter Skene Ogden's Hudson's Bay Company party deserted to join American trappers, and Ogden withdrew from the valley.
simp_chinese: 摩根谷地沿韦伯河分布，位于大盐湖以东的山中。毛皮捕猎者到来之前，肖肖尼人与犹特人早已熟悉这一带的河谷和山路。十九世纪二十年代，英国与美国的捕猎队进入这片土地寻找海狸。1825年，双方在芒廷格林附近发生竞争：彼得·斯基恩·奥格登率领的哈德逊湾公司队伍中，有人离队加入美国捕猎者，奥格登随后撤出谷地。

english:
Morgex belongs to the upper Aosta Valley, where a cultivated valley floor and surrounding Alpine slopes supported farming, livestock and travel between mountain communities. Vineyards and other fields used favourable ground, while higher pastures allowed seasonal grazing. Roads through the valley connected local settlements with passes leading beyond the Alps, making transport and provisioning important alongside rural production. Weather and snow could sharply change the conditions of movement.

The Tour de l'Archet, with its massive square tower, stands in the centre of Morgex. Its surrounding buildings were added in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, and the complex long belonged to the de l'Archet family. The count of Savoy stayed there for general audiences at which his direct subjects paid feudal homage. Alpine warfare also reached the valley: a local historical account records that French forces burned Morgex and neighbouring La Salle in 1691.
simp_chinese:
莫尔热属于奥斯塔河谷上游，耕作谷地与周围阿尔卑斯山坡支持农业、畜养和山地社区之间的旅行。葡萄园及其他田地利用有利土地，较高牧场则供季节放牧。河谷道路把地方聚落同越过山脉的山口连接起来，使运输和补给同农村生产一样重要。天气与积雪能够突然改变通行条件。

镇中心的阿尔谢塔以厚重方塔为核心，周围建筑在十二至十三世纪陆续增建，城堡长期属于德拉尔谢家族。萨伏依伯爵曾在此举行公开觐见，接受直属臣民的封建效忠。阿尔卑斯地区的战争也波及河谷：地方历史记载，法军于1691年焚毁莫尔热及邻近的拉萨勒。

english: Morhange was a town of Lorraine whose medieval lordship belonged to the house of Salm before coming under the dukes of Lorraine. Its fortified position and old tower gave the settlement a place in the contested country between the duchy and the bishopric of Metz. During the wars that ravaged Lorraine in the seventeenth century, fighting reached Morhange; a battle was fought here in 1641. The town's history reflects the changing fortunes of the local lords and the wider duchy.
simp_chinese: 莫朗日是洛林的一座城镇，中世纪领地曾属萨尔姆家族，后来归于洛林公爵。设防位置和旧塔使它在公国与梅斯主教领之间的争夺地区占有一席之地。十七世纪战火蹂躏洛林时，莫朗日也受到波及；1641年这里发生了一场战斗。城镇的经历与地方领主及整个公国的兴衰相连。

english: Mori lies at the northern foot of the eastern Tianshan, on the southeastern margin of the Dzungarian basin. Mountain streams, including the Mori River, descend toward the dry plains, while grasslands occupy the higher slopes. After the Qing defeated the Dzungars, a fort and grain administration were established at Dongjiermatai in 1759. One explanation derives the name Mori from a Mongolian word for a bend in a river.
simp_chinese: 木垒位于东天山北麓、准噶尔盆地东南缘。木垒河等溪流从山间流向干旱平原，高处山坡则有草场。清朝平定准噶尔后，于1759年在东吉尔玛台筑堡并设管粮巡检。木垒一名有一种解释认为来自蒙古语的河湾。

english: Mori Baridag lies in the upper Selenge country of northern Mongolia, where rivers flow between the Khangai uplands and the forests towards Lake Baikal. A medieval burial at Mori Baridag belongs to the period of the Mongol Empire, preserving evidence of people who lived in this broad river basin. The Selenge basin combines mountain ranges, scattered woodland and grassland under a climate of severe winters and warm summers.
simp_chinese: 莫里巴里达格位于蒙古北部色楞格河上游地区，河流穿过杭爱高地与森林之间，流向贝加尔湖。当地一座中世纪墓葬属于蒙古帝国时期，留下这片广大流域居民的痕迹。色楞格流域山脉、零散林地和草原交错，冬季严寒，夏季温暖。

english: Mori lies in the interior of central Sulawesi, in the country of the Laa River and its highland valleys. The name originally referred to communities on the river's upper course. From the late sixteenth century a kingdom known as Mori or Wita Mori took shape in this region, among the inland peoples east of Lake Poso and north of Lake Matano.
simp_chinese: 末里位于苏拉威西中部内陆，处在拉阿河及其高地河谷地区。这个名称最初指河流上游的社群。十六世纪末起，一个称为末里或维塔末里的王国在当地形成，位于波索湖以东、马塔诺湖以北的内陆居民之间。

english: Morki was established in 1678 in the forested country of the Mari, north of the middle Volga. The Mari lived in the lands between the Volga and Vyatka, where local communities practiced agriculture and maintained traditions distinct from those of their Russian neighbors. The settlement arose after the conquest of Kazan had brought the region under Russian rule. Its Mari name, Morko, preserves the language of the people who inhabited the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 莫尔基建立于1678年，位于中伏尔加河北方马里人的林地。马里人居住在伏尔加河与维亚特卡河之间，地方社群从事农业，保有不同于俄罗斯邻人的传统。聚落出现之前，征服喀山已使这一地区归于俄罗斯统治。当地的马里语名称莫尔科，保留了周围乡村居民的语言。

english: The Morkoka flows through a deep valley in the Vilyuy Plateau of western Yakutia. Rising from Lake Bayyttakh, it joins the Markha, whose waters continue to the Vilyuy and Lena. The river crosses a remote northern forest landscape, freezing in the long winter and swelling with the return of warmer weather and melting snow.
simp_chinese: 莫尔科卡河流经雅库特西部维柳伊高原的深谷。它发源于巴伊特塔赫湖，汇入马尔哈河，河水随后流向维柳伊河与勒拿河。河流穿过偏远的北方森林地带，漫长冬季封冻，暖季与融雪到来时水量上涨。

english: Morkvash lies at the foot of the Zhiguli hills on the great bend of the Volga known as Samarskaya Luka. The village is associated with a landscape of steep slopes, wooded ravines and the river's long curve around the hills. It was recorded in the seventeenth century; in 1695 Peter I's fleet passed the village on its way toward Azov and anchored nearby because of bad weather. The Volga carried travellers and armies past this small settlement.
simp_chinese: 莫尔克瓦什位于日古利山麓，地处伏尔加河称为萨马拉大弯的一段河曲。陡坡、林木覆盖的沟谷和绕山而行的长长河湾构成这里的景观。村庄见于17世纪的记载；1695年，彼得一世的船队在前往亚速途中经过，并因天气恶劣在附近抛锚。伏尔加河将旅人与军队带过这座小聚落。

english: Mormor lies in Bale near the Ganale River and holds a special place in the traditions of the Oromo of Hararghe. They remember it as a homeland from which their ancestors moved during the sixteenth century, and as a sacred destination of pilgrimage. Envoys known as jila travelled to the Abbaa Muudaa, the spiritual father, to receive blessings and bring them back to their communities.
simp_chinese: 莫尔莫尔位于巴莱、加纳莱河附近，在哈勒尔盖奥罗莫人的传统中占有特殊地位。他们记得这片故土，祖先曾在十六世纪从这里迁出；这里也是神圣的朝圣目的地。被称为“吉拉”的使者前往拜见精神领袖阿巴·穆达，接受祝福并将其带回自己的社群。

english:
Mornei stands in the Nori valley of western Darfur, near the Achamara hills. The valley lies within the country associated with the Masalit, whose settlements and cultivated lands are interspersed with the pastures used by neighbouring communities. Seasonal streams and the rains give shape to a landscape that changes markedly between the wet and dry months, as fields and grazing grounds follow the rhythm of the Sahelian year.

The later city of Zalingei lies here.
simp_chinese:
莫尔内位于达尔富尔西部的诺里河谷，靠近阿查马拉丘陵。河谷属于与马撒利特人相关的地区，他们的聚落和耕地与邻近社群使用的牧场交错分布。季节性溪流和雨水塑造了这片景观：旱季与雨季面貌迥异，田地和牧场随着萨赫勒一年中的季节变换而变化。

后来的扎林盖即位于此地。

sources.title: 287221169 Contested land rights and ethnic conflict in Mornei West Darfur Scarcity of resources or crises of governance

english: Moro was a name associated with communities of northern Halmahera and nearby Morotai. Local traditions remember Mamuya among the early centers of this region, while accounts of the sixteenth century name settlements along its coasts. In the memory of the Tobelo people, the Moro also belong to the spirit world of the forest, a reminder of the enduring place of earlier inhabitants in the region's stories.
simp_chinese: 摩罗是与哈马黑拉北部及附近摩罗泰岛社群有关的名称。当地传统将马穆亚记作这一地区早期中心之一，十六世纪的记述也提及其沿岸聚落。在托贝洛人的记忆中，摩罗还属于森林的灵界，体现出早先居民在地区故事中延续的地位。

english: Moro Gulf lies along southwestern Mindanao, bounded by the Zamboanga Peninsula and the island's southern coast. Illana Bay and Sibuguey Bay form deep inlets within it. The great Mindanao River drains the Cotabato Basin into Illana Bay, carrying water from an interior basin enclosed by mountain ranges to the sea.
simp_chinese: 摩洛湾位于棉兰老岛西南部，三宝颜半岛与岛屿南岸环绕其水域。伊利亚纳湾和锡布盖湾是湾内深入陆地的海湾。棉兰老大河将山脉环抱的哥打巴托盆地水流带入伊利亚纳湾，最终汇入大海。

english: Moro lies in the Indus plain of Sindh, on the route between Hyderabad and Rohri. Near the town is the mausoleum of Nur Muhammad Kalhora, the eighteenth-century ruler who extended Kalhora authority across the river and consolidated much of Sindh under one government.
